content.cast.the-festival.kettil.3.bark.0: 三只山羊，其中一只是麻烦精。
content.cast.the-festival.oskar.0.bark.0: 蛋糕正在静置。蛋糕旁边谁都不许摔门。
content.cast.the-festival.runa.0.bark.0: 苔苔！苔苔！有谁看见一匹灰母马吗？
content.cast.the-festival.runa.1.bark.0: 母马在歇着。母马就是要歇着的，母马都这样。

content.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.0.label: 城堡很老了吧？
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.1.label: 有什么值得一看的吗？
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.2.label: 潮水退了。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.3.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.text: 亲爱的，这样的庆典我看了六十一届，每一届都差点办不成。去吧。今晚我坐第一排。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-legend.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-legend.text: 比你想的还老。我丈夫家的人一口咬定，古时的领主们在最后一次围城前，把最好的兵器藏在了城里某处，之后再没回来取。我在上头住了四十年，除了穿堂风，就只找到一支怎么也不肯躺下的守军，于是我搬到了镇上。也许真有其事吧。就算有，也没人知道该怎么进去。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-sights.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-sights.text: 要是爬坡爬得腿受不了，客栈马厩的露娜出租她的灰母马。铁匠托瓦尔在主街的柜台上卖好铁器，用镇上发的便士就能买。我小时候，大教堂后面的山丘里有个山洞，满洞翠绿，还会发光。我想它还在那儿。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tide.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tide.text: Agathe 夫人一下子愣住了。随后她笑了出来，那是少女的笑声，对前排贵宾席来说实在太响了。“Magnhild！那个无法无天的丫头。她还守着那个地窖？当然还守着。”她压低了声音，“一年十一磅，整整六十一年，Oskar 从来没问过一句糖是打哪儿来的。好人哪，Oskar。不过可别让 Vidar Foss 听见一个字。他非得去翻那条章程不可，那他一整晚就都毁了。”
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.opt.0.label: 城堡那边呢？
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.opt.1.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.text: 一只狐狸。在我的库房里。叼着我的钥匙。现在它叼着钥匙跑上山路去了，抓不到它，烟花就一直锁在里面。我本该自己去的，可我已经不上城堡了。自从那支守军又开始站起来以后就没去过。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-fox.opt.0.label: 我们应付得来。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-fox.text: 这么说有人看见那只狐狸了。拿到钥匙后，当心城堡：城里一安静，老守军就会在院子里站起来，他们还不知道自己早死了。烟花在大厅底下的地窖里，就在那道旧铁栅后面，而铁栅只有在院子里的四堆烽火按正确顺序点起来时才会升起。我把顺序写了下来，字条放在井边我的箱子里。点错一个，所有火都会熄灭。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-legend.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-legend.text: 鬼故事罢了。阿加特夫人家里的人说，城堡里某个地方藏着老领主们的宝贝。那城堡我扫了四十年，要真有，那它藏得可比我库房的钥匙好多了。
content.dlg.cat.cat-asks.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.cat.cat-asks.text: “有值得说的话，本猫才开口。听好了：这池子里有鳕鱼。五条，劳驾。要鳕鱼，不要鲑鱼。也不要那种带条纹的小鱼：那是另一回事，今天不提。用那根钓竿。钓上来放进碗里。本猫会以本猫的方式感谢你。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.0.label: 我们把皮普送上去。
content.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.0.tooltip: 用桶把皮普舀起来，送到上面的池子去。
content.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.1.label: 你好，皮普。
content.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.2.label: 几千种什么？
content.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.3.label: 再见，猫。
content.dlg.cat.cat-cave.text: 洞里一片翠绿，滴着水，被会发光的浆果照亮。猫坐在下层池塘边，身旁是一只粉色的小美西螈。“这是皮普。皮普懂鱼。所有的鱼。尤其是那种带条纹的小鱼，那种鱼有好几千种，而本猫……本猫怎样不重要。皮普想去上面那个有光的池子。本猫提不了桶。你能。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-home.opt.0.label: 那东西是什么？
content.dlg.cat.cat-home.opt.1.label: 谢谢你，猫。
content.dlg.cat.cat-home.text: 猫坐在老矿工小屋旁舔着爪子。“本猫的窝是本猫的。箱子里的东西，现在归你了。本猫用不着了：本猫已经退隐江湖。大体上。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.0.label: 还有别处好看吗？
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.0.tooltip: 还有什么好玩的地方能带我去看看吗？
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.1.label: 就再一个地方？
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.1.tooltip: 就再一个地方嘛？哪儿都行？
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.2.label: 你哪儿都熟。
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.2.tooltip: 这镇上每个角落你都熟，对吧？
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.3.label: 我给你找条鲑鱼。
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.3.tooltip: 求你了？我给你找条鲑鱼来。
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.4.label: 我不走了。
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.4.tooltip: 你不带我去，我就不走了。
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.5.label: 睡个好觉，猫。
content.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.text: 猫躺在洞口晒太阳，闭着眼，尾巴搭在鼻子上。一只耳朵朝你转了过来。
content.dlg.cat.cat-pip.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.cat.cat-pip.text: 皮普抬头看着你笑，美西螈都是这么笑的。“她的朋友？那你听好：红底白纹的鲷鱼，和白底红纹的鲷鱼，不是一回事。没人听得进去。她听。她跟我研究过两百一十一种，一种都没弄混过。”猫抬头望着洞顶。
content.dlg.cat.cat-pond.opt.0.label: 你刚才说话了？
content.dlg.cat.cat-pond.opt.0.tooltip: 一只会说话的猫。当然了，今天可是节日。
content.dlg.cat.cat-pond.opt.1.label: 要几条鳕鱼来着？
content.dlg.cat.cat-pond.opt.2.label: 再见，猫。
content.dlg.cat.cat-pond.text: 一只缺了只耳尖的大灰猫坐在岸边，盯着池塘，就像别人盯着一扇门。她斜过一只眼睛看你。“咪。你。你有手。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-1.opt.0.label: 嗯。
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-1.text: “本猫吃过了。本猫现在要睡觉了。别烦本猫。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-2.opt.0.label: 嗯。
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-2.text: “本猫睡着了。这就是睡着的本猫。要看本猫睡觉，请安静地，到别处去看。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-3.opt.0.label: 嗯。
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-3.text: “十一座港口、两座山、一片沙漠，本猫哪个角落都熟。本猫不说。本猫在消化。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-4.opt.0.label: 嗯。
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-4.text: “鲑鱼。本猫吃过鲑鱼，捞自一条往山上流的河，在一个你听都没听过的国度。别拿吃的诱惑本猫。本猫睡着了。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-5.opt.0.label: 嗯。
content.dlg.cat.cat-round-5.text: “喵——呜。行吧。看来是甩不掉你了。再带你去一个地方。跟紧了，不是你的东西别碰。有些东西可是很锋利的。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-thing.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.cat.cat-thing.text: “那尊石头的？仿得不像。真的那只本猫见过，在另一座镇子，比这儿阴郁多了：天天下雨，没人笑。让它跑了。”猫的胡子抖了抖。“可惜。烤成章鱼，一定很香。”
content.dlg.cat.cat-thousands.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.cat.cat-thousands.text: “没什么。鱼而已。本猫不过是随口聊聊。”猫一本正经地舔起了爪子。在她身后，皮普吐了个泡泡，听着很像在偷笑。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.opt.0.label: 有什么值得一看的吗？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.opt.1.label: 笑着呢。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.text: 进展如何？别告诉我。黄昏再告诉我。对着镇上的人笑一笑。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.0.label: 我们准备好了。让他们来吧。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.0.tooltip: 没有回头路：掠夺马上开始，镇上别的事都得等这一仗打完。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.1.label: 还没好。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.2.label: 我们守着街呢！
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.text: 你们回来啦！都弄好了吗？灯、钟、山羊、货箱、烟花？那就往灯塔外头看看吧，亲爱的，我盯了一下午了。条纹帆。那是海鸥船长，哪年听说我们有个值得抢的蛋糕，他就哪年来。今年他还带了朋友，块头都不小。他的号角一响，就别想在镇上到处跑了：守着这座台子、这条主街、这个蛋糕，直到打完为止。所以先准备好。托瓦尔的柜台上卖好铁器，今天镇上给了你们什么，都带上。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.0.label: 那边在嚷什么？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.1.label: 我们来帮忙。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.1.tooltip: 交给我们：不管出了什么岔子，黄昏前都给你摆平。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.text: 早上好，凯尔德比！早上好，新来的朋友们！今天是庆典：广场上摆宴席，黄昏敲钟，灯塔的灯照着海湾，午夜城堡放烟花。绝对不可能出任何岔子。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.opt.0.label: 开始吧。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.opt.0.tooltip: 宣布庆典开始，不管这一天把它变成了什么样。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.text: 看看他们。看看这么多人。好吧。今天不管发生了什么，那就是今年的庆典了。我开始了？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-sights.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-sights.text: 奥斯卡的猪赛，你们什么时候敢就什么时候去：骑着他的赛猪绕全镇一圈，一猪一人，半路还要穿过大教堂。去面包房门口问他。还有，海滩后面的集市场摆满了摊子，每个摊子都在送东西。听说鸭塘边那只大灰猫会说话，前提是它看你顺眼。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-troubles.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-troubles.text: 那个？那是所有事一起出岔子了。造船匠的货船在海湾里翻了，宴席的东西全在船上。箍桶匠的山羊跑上了梯田。钟绳断了。灯塔的灯半夜灭了，守塔人正在上面骂它。挑一件。全挑也行。黄昏前回到这座舞台。
content.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.opt.0.label: 我们上去。
content.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.text: 凌晨三点灭的。灯芯没事，油也没事，就是这灯在闹脾气。还有，上去的楼梯塌了三处，你得跳过去。帮我点上，我欠你个人情。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-day.opt.0.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-day.text: 要是你在不该有山羊的地方看见山羊，那就是我家的。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-gaveup.opt.0.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-gaveup.text: 最后还是我自己去把它们找回来的。它们在一个你今晚会看到的地方等着，在哪儿我可不说。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-goats.opt.0.label: 我们把它们带回来。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-goats.opt.0.tooltip: 去田里拿些小麦，把三只山羊引回这个羊圈。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-goats.text: 我那三只山羊跑出圈了。珍珠，我那几只母羊里最小的一只，上了鱼贩铺子后面的梯田，钻进了小路上方的果园。大麦，凯尔德比产奶最多的山羊，在城堡山路往上走一小段的路边泉水那儿。还有海军上将，就是拨开门闩的那只老公羊，在农场小路那头的果园里。每只头顶上都有名字，见了小麦走到哪儿都跟着。麦田就在农场小路那头。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-herding.opt.0.label: 它们又在哪儿来着？
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-herding.opt.1.label: 今天还有别的事吗？
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-herding.opt.2.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-herding.text: 把小麦举高，让它们看得见，然后慢慢走。记住，是主街上的这个圈：不是羊倌的绵羊圈，也不是牛圈。山羊一进这个圈就老实待着，所以你一只一只带回来也行。三只都进来了，就把门闩放下。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-lost.opt.0.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-lost.text: 剩下的两只我已经关进圈了。另一只的事，今天我不想说。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-thanks.opt.0.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-thanks.text: 三只都回家了，门闩也放下了。珍珠、大麦、海军上将。你的事我都跟它们讲过了。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-tip.opt.0.label: 我记住了。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-tip.text: 还有一件事。露娜的灰母马？不给钱，露娜可不会借。不过你要是想白骑，就告诉露娜她姐姐家的母牛要生了。为了那头牛，她连着火的马厩都能扔下不管。这话可不是我说的。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-where.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-where.text: 珍珠在梯田上的果园里：顺着主街下到鱼铺，穿过它的后院上梯田小路，沿路走到上方的果园。大麦在路边泉那儿，就是从广场上城堡路的第一站。将军在农场小道尽头的果园里：沿着这个羊圈旁边的五号巷走，过了池塘就到。
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.opt.0.label: 这是什么地方？
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.opt.1.label: 袋子里装的什么？
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.opt.2.label: 是谁创立的？
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.opt.3.label: 再见，Magnhild。
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.text: 酒桶堆中间摆着一张牌桌，一位穿水手外套的老太太正就着烛光玩单人纸牌，而且正在输。她头也不抬。“当心梯子，伙计，那梯子咬人。哎呀呀，十一年了，没一个人找到下来的路。坐吧——要是你能找着一个没装满的桶的话。”
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-founder.opt.0.tool: Magnhild 把会里最后一份分红给你：一盏没有玻璃罩的提灯——当年的暗号——外加三枚便士。
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-founder.text: “那个划小船的姑娘？”Magnhild 翻开一张牌，对着它笑了。“她每年都穿着绿外套坐在节日的前排，全镇的人都叫她夫人。去告诉她，潮水退了。说的时候，瞧瞧她的脸色。”她把一样东西从桌上推了过来。“还有，把会里的这份拿去。也没别人可给了。”
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-society.text: “Kelderby 自由商人会。你要叫走私贩子也行，可别大声叫。六十一年前就在这个地窖里成立，创始人是个十九岁的姑娘，有一条划艇，天不怕地不怕。那年我十二岁，负责提灯。”她把一张牌放错了牌堆。“我们以前有九个人。现在剩一个。我叫 Magnhild，就是剩下的那一个。”
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-sugar.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-sugar.text: “糖。”她说这个字的口气，就像别人说“金子”。“章程第四十一条：凡运进 Kelderby 的糖，都得过行会的秤，一盎司一便士。节日蛋糕顶上那座糖做的灯塔，要用十一磅糖。你自己算算，伙计。这镇上谁付得起？所以每年节日前一周，总有十一磅糖趁夜从礁石那边上岸，用的是一条不点灯的船，然后 Oskar 就在他家后门台阶上发现它们，他一次都没问过。”她拍了拍最近的一只袋子。“今年的。最后一趟。我这膝盖再也跑不动了。”
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-goats.opt.0.label: 你会收手吗？
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-goats.opt.0.tooltip: 请这位家精从今往后别再招惹箍桶匠的山羊。
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-goats.opt.1.label: 返回。
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-goats.text: 他放下勺子。“山羊。箍桶匠的山羊，每逢节日早上就从关好的圈里溜出来，上山去，跟受了邀请似的。”他又拿起勺子。“是我邀请的。门闩这东西，对我们这种人来说简单得很。三年了，它们年年跑，三年了没一个人想过为什么。好吧。现在我喝上粥了。”
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.opt.0.label: 你是谁？
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.opt.1.label: 想不通什么？
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.opt.2.label: 这些都是什么？
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.opt.3.label: 再见，Nisse。
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.text: 谷仓底下，一间垂满树根的厅堂里，一张还没你膝盖高的桌子旁，一个戴红帽子的小老头正在喝粥，那架势像是生怕有人来抢。他的胡子都泡在粥里了。“三个节日，”他头也不抬地说，“三个节日，一个人也没有。然后他们还想不通。”
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-hoard.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-hoard.text: “都是人家掉了、再没回来找的东西。谁捡到归谁，这是世上最老的规矩，比书记员那些章程还老。”一副只剩一块镜片的眼镜。一把糖勺。四十一只不成对的袜子，按颜色分好了。一个钟舌。“那是公会厅的。书记员拿借来的钟舌敲了二十年钟了。别告诉他：他会要回去的。”
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-promise.opt.0.label: 再见，Nisse。
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-promise.text: “收手？我已经收手了。说好的就是说好的。”他擦了擦胡子。“今晚山羊睡在圈里，谷仓的母牛出一个礼拜的奶油。这些你可以告诉箍桶匠。别告诉他为什么：他准会摆一碟牛奶出来，我又不是猫。”
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-who.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.nisse.nisse-who.text: “我是谁。我是谁！我是这座农场的主人，就是我。那座谷仓立起第一根梁的时候我就在了，那根梁心里有数。上头生下的每一头小牛，我都守过夜。每一只母鸡，我都数过。一年一碗粥，节日前夜，上面放黄油：这就是约定，守了三百年。你的高祖母就守着。她比你有礼貌多了，你连坐都还没坐下呢。”
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.opt.0.label: 猪赛？
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.opt.1.label: 有什么值得一看的吗？
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.opt.2.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.text: 蛋糕做好了。四层，糖渍樱桃，顶上一座糖做的灯塔。黄昏摆上舞台，午夜之前谁也不许对着它喘气。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-race.opt.0.label: 我们来比。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-race.opt.0.tooltip: 奥斯卡的车把你们一行人全都拉到起跑线，不管各自在哪儿，比赛就此开始：这一天别的事都得等比完再说。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-race.opt.1.label: 返回。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-race.text: 我的赛猪！天一亮就上好鞍了，一直在那儿吃个不停。绕全镇一圈：穿过农场后面的树林往上，经过大教堂的花园和墓园，从大教堂的侧门进去，从正门大门出来，再沿主街往下，顺着下面那条小巷回到草场小路。沿途每个检查点都得按顺序过，不然不算数。有个叫乌拉的车夫连赢了三年，到现在还挂在嘴边。跟她比一场？
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-sights.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-sights.text: 我的柜台卖面包和馅饼，用镇上的便士买，今天也照卖。要是想要蜂蜜，就去海滩后面的蜂草地：蜂箱都满了，蜂蜜摊里有空瓶子，谁装归谁。城堡路上的瞭望台是凯尔德比视野最好的地方，常有人在那儿留下些东西。
content.dlg.runa.runa-day.opt.0.label: 祝你今天愉快。
content.dlg.runa.runa-day.opt.1.label: 你姐姐家的牛要下崽了！
content.dlg.runa.runa-day.opt.1.tooltip: 凯蒂尔出的主意：把露娜支到农场小道上去看她姐姐家要生的母牛，趁她不在把母马牵走。
content.dlg.runa.runa-day.text: 苔苔在后面的马厩里。在那边的木桶那儿可以租她，付铜板就行——今天镇上谁修好了点什么，就发给谁铜板。可别骑着她在主街上狂奔。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-cargo.opt.0.label: 我们划出去。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-cargo.opt.0.tooltip: 划斯韦勒的船出海湾，把货箱带回来。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-cargo.text: 船在沙洲上翻了，可不是嘛。宴席的六箱货漂到了深水那头的浅滩上，还有两箱漂出了外沙洲；从靠港口那头的水道绕出去。坐鲱鱼号，就是台阶边那条，她划起来最稳。潮水一涨，那些箱子可漂不了多久。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.opt.0.label: 有什么值得一看的吗？
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.opt.1.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.text: 当心沙洲。船可不当心，所以才落到这步田地。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-sights.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-sights.text: 港务所上面的游戏场摊子里有奖品；从码头尽头顺小路过去的射箭靶场，给每个带弓的人备着一捆箭。烽火岬上的海鸥很大方，要是看你顺眼的话。小农庄的那只母鸡也是。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.opt.0.label: 铁人？
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.opt.1.label: 铁人怎么样了？
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.opt.2.label: 铁人怎么样了？
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.opt.3.label: 祝你今天愉快。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.text: 炉子冷着。放假。门边的柜台卖我这一冬打出来的东西，收镇上的节日铜板。后头还站着一个铁人，我从下雪那天起就在打它。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-head.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-head.text: 浑身是铁，只差一个头。铁人的头是一个雕好的南瓜，五官俱全，可今早凯尔德比的南瓜全都刻成灯笼了；稻草人不会把自己的脑袋让出来，别去打它们的主意。等宴席的箱子都上了岸，把南瓜放到那边的铁砧上，他就能看见了。做灯笼的人在码头尽头再过去的菜园里放了一桶。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-headed.opt.0.label: 唤醒他（5 便士）
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-headed.opt.0.tooltip: 给托瓦尔看 5 便士，他的铁人就会在黄昏走到广场上，和你们并肩作战。队伍的钱袋里不满 5 便士，托瓦尔不接这活。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-headed.opt.1.label: 返回。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-headed.text: 他有头了，看得见了。唤醒他才是贵的那部分：付我 5 便士，他就会在黄昏走到广场上，站在需要帮手的人身边。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-hired.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-hired.text: 太阳一落山他就会在广场上。别叫他跳舞。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-wake.opt.0.label: 成交。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-wake.opt.0.tooltip: 付托瓦尔 5 便士，让他在黄昏前唤醒铁人。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-wake.opt.1.label: 返回。
content.dlg.torvald.torvald-wake.text: 5 便士。木炭、风箱，外加我一个礼拜的觉。成交吗？
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.0.label: 有什么值得一看的吗？
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.1.label: 把弓给我。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.1.tooltip: 接过维达的弓箭，去射钟楼里的靶子。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.text: 镇规第十四条：黄昏鸣钟。今早钟绳断了，绳结卡在钟楼窗口的箭靶上，谁也够不着。我有一把弓，可我这辈子一次也没射中过东西。干净利落地射中三箭，就能把绳结震下来。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-sights.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-sights.text: 第九条规章：大教堂花园里的草药摊，谁饿了谁吃。第十二条规章：在庆典日，也只有在庆典日，猪可以骑着穿过大教堂，从侧门进、正门出，前提是它在比赛。去问奥斯卡。规章对猪的规定非常明确。第三条规章：不许喂鸭塘边那只猫。从来没人遵守过第三条。那只猫自有办法。
content.fx.dusk.done.1.outcome: 你把强盗挡在了舞台下，奥斯卡的蛋糕完好无损。
content.fx.dusk.done.11.narrate: 入夜了。彩旗和灯笼挂满了主街，全镇的人沿街走上广场，庆典开始了。
content.fx.dusk.done.12.narrate: 夜里。条纹帆已经驶过了灯塔，蛋糕和宴席也跟着走了。镇上的人还是顺着主街来到广场，因为一向如此。
content.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.13.narrate: 伯恩特把城堡的弩和白天抢下来的烟花一车拉到了舞台边。“火箭装在放弩箭的地方。对准船。别对准蛋糕。”
你在广场对面旅店酒堂的长凳上醒过来。有人给你留了一块馅饼。
灯塔的光束转过来停住了：又有船冲上了港口那边的海滩！还有三十口气的工夫。
content.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.22.narrate: 铛。铛。托瓦尔的铁人顶着南瓜脑袋走上广场，转身面朝海湾。
content.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.3.outcome: 到黄昏苔苔也没回来；露娜提着灯在山坡上找了一整晚，喊着她的名字，错过了整场庆典。
content.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.8.narrate: 海湾里传来号角声。三条挂着条纹帆的矮船：掠夺者来抢庆典了。海达说，他们就是冲着蛋糕来的。
content.fx.dusk.oc.hold-the-beach.1.narrate: 号角声更响了。最后一条船上站起一个人，帽子上的羽毛长得能戳瞎人，他伸手指向蛋糕。
content.fx.dusk.oc.hold-the-dock.1.narrate: 号角声更响了。最后一条船上站起一个人，帽子上的羽毛长得能戳瞎人，他伸手指向蛋糕。
content.fx.opening.done.0.narrate: 海达对着整个广场喊：“凯尔德比！一切尽在掌握！”她身后有人边跑边喊山羊的事。
content.fx.opening.done.3.narrate: 奥斯卡把庆典蛋糕摆上舞台的桌子：四层高，顶上立着一座糖做的灯塔。
content.fx.shop.bakery.0.0.narrate: 奥斯卡用布包好三条面包。“别放在蛋糕那张桌子上，拜托了。”
content.fx.shop.bakery.0.1.narrate: 奥斯卡看着你空空的手。“面包一个铜板。今天也一样。”
content.fx.shop.bakery.1.0.narrate: 奥斯卡把派递过来，那架势像是在递一个小蛋糕。“坐下来吃。”
content.fx.shop.bakery.1.1.narrate: 奥斯卡看着你空空的手。“派一个铜板。今天也一样。”
content.fx.shop.forge.0.0.narrate: 托瓦尔把剑横放在你掌心。“刃朝外。永远刃朝外。”
content.fx.shop.forge.0.1.narrate: 托瓦尔数了数你的铜板，又掂了掂剑的价钱。“不够。”
content.fx.shop.forge.1.0.narrate: 托瓦尔在盾牌上敲了两下，递给你。“它扛得住比这更狠的。”
content.fx.shop.forge.1.1.narrate: 托瓦尔数了数你的铜板，又掂了掂盾牌的价钱。“不够。”
content.fx.shop.forge.2.0.narrate: 托瓦尔亲手把头盔扣到你头上，冲它点了点头。
content.fx.shop.forge.2.1.narrate: 托瓦尔数了数你的铜板，又掂了掂头盔的价钱。“不够。”
content.fx.shop.forge.3.0.narrate: 托瓦尔替你扣好胸甲，退后一步看了看。“好。”
content.fx.shop.forge.3.1.narrate: 托瓦尔数了数你的铜板，又掂了掂胸甲的价钱。“不够。”
content.fx.shop.stable.0.0.narrate: 露娜把你的铜板数了两遍，把苔苔牵到广场边的拴马桩旁。“别过了黄昏。还有，她不喜欢海。”
content.fx.shop.stable.0.1.narrate: 露娜看看你的铜板，又看看你。“这可不够一匹马的钱。”
content.fx.shop.stable.0.2.outcome: 你花四个节日铜板，从露娜那儿租下了苔苔。
content.fx.the-bell.oc.ring-the-bell.0.outcome: 你往钟楼的靶子上射中了三箭，庆典的钟准时敲响了。
content.fx.the-bell.oc.ring-the-bell.2.narrate: 钟声响彻广场。维达热泪盈眶，说这一声分秒不差，郑重地记进了本子。
content.fx.the-cargo.oc.ask-sverre.1.narrate: 斯韦勒阴沉沉地补了一句：“还有，当心浅滩那边的溺尸。它们这一上午可无聊坏了。”
content.fx.the-cargo.oc.crate-1.0.outcome: 你划船出去，把第一只货箱里的东西全倒进了船里。
content.fx.the-cargo.oc.crate-2.0.outcome: 你划船出去，把第二只货箱里的东西全倒进了船里。
content.fx.the-cargo.oc.crate-3.0.outcome: 你划船出去，把第三只货箱里的东西全倒进了船里。

content.fx.the-cat-cave.oc.carry-pip.3.narrate: 你把皮普倒进上层池塘。皮普沉到池底，转了两圈，笑了，美西螈总是这么笑。
content.fx.the-cat-cave.oc.carry-pip.5.narrate: 猫走到洞口，在阳光里坐下，闭上了眼睛。“很好。本猫吃饱了，本猫做了件好事。现在本猫要睡了。”
content.fx.the-cat-cave.oc.meet-pip.1.narrate: 猫用脑袋把一只瘪了的水桶推给你。“舀。轻点。皮普只咬本猫不喜欢的人。”
content.fx.the-cat-den.oc.down-to-the-den.1.narr: 在对面的岩架上，避开从深渊里往上灌的风：这就是猫的窝。一个被压出猫形的垫子，一台砂轮，猫的旧碗，墙上一块写满鱼名的木牌，还有一只箱子。在你身后，冷光之中，深渊里那尊巨大的石像依旧没有看你。
猫用身子抵着小屋里角那台旧织布机，直到它滑开。下面是一扇活板门，活板门底下是一架梯子，往黑暗里伸下去好远好远。“本猫的。去吧。本猫在上面等你。过桥小心。”
content.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-1.0.narrate: 猫三口吃掉了第一条鳕鱼，闭着眼睛，像是在许多港口都吃过鳕鱼、正在细细比较的人。
content.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-2.0.narrate: 猫盯着第二条鳕鱼看了好一阵，就像剑客打量陌生人的架势，然后还是把它吃了。
content.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-3.0.narrate: 猫慢慢吃着第三条鳕鱼。“水凉。池子背阴。尚可。”
content.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-4.0.narrate: 第四条鳕鱼步了前几条的后尘。猫舔了舔一只爪子，有那么一瞬，她的爪尖探了出来，又长又干净。
content.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-5.0.narrate: 猫吃完第五条鳕鱼，坐直了身子，又大又心满意足。“很好。现在本猫带你去见个朋友。一个聪明的朋友。跟上。别磨蹭。”
content.fx.the-cat.oc.meet-the-cat.1.narrate: 猫从长凳底下拱出一根旧钓竿。它保养得很好：鱼线是新的，鱼钩锋利得很。
content.fx.the-festival.done.0.narrate: 露娜在广场上看烟花，口袋里揣着一根胡萝卜，留给马厩里的母马。
content.fx.the-festival.done.1.narrate: 山坡那边，一盏灯在果园的树间晃来晃去：露娜还在喊她的母马，一颗烟花也没看上。
content.fx.the-festival.done.10.narrate: 奥斯卡的蛋糕好端端地立在舞台上，四层，顶上一座糖灯塔，一点没碰着。
content.fx.the-festival.done.2.narrate: 灯塔的光束扫过广场，每一张脸都随着它抬了起来。
content.fx.the-festival.done.3.narrate: 午夜钟声准时敲响，庆典开始了。
content.fx.the-festival.done.31.narrate: 城堡的烟花铺满了整片夜空，一直放到镇上的狗都叫累了。
content.fx.the-festival.done.32.narrate: 几支烟花一支接一支地升空，每支之间都礼貌地隔上一会儿。全镇的人为每一支都单独欢呼了一遍。
content.fx.the-festival.done.33.narrate: 海达展开另一份讲稿，那份是为另一种庆典写的，对着空荡荡的桌子念了起来。
content.fx.the-festival.done.34.narrate: 没有宴席。没有蛋糕。掠夺者正在海上某处吃着这两样，镇上的人只能揣着手站在广场上。
content.fx.the-festival.done.35.narrate: 斯韦勒的货箱今早白捞了：熏鱼和奶酪都坐着掠夺者的船出海了。
content.fx.the-festival.done.36.narrate: 凯蒂尔的山羊在啃空了的宴席桌。今晚整个凯尔德比，只有它们吃上了东西。
content.fx.the-festival.done.37.narrate: 伯恩特朝船追着放了一支烟花。它没飞多远就掉进了海湾，没有人欢呼。
content.fx.the-festival.done.4.narrate: 宴席沿着广场摆开：熏鱼、奶酪、蜂蜜蛋糕，还有一整只火腿——全是今早从海湾里捞回来的。
content.fx.the-festival.done.5.narrate: 宴席桌上只有面包，好多好多面包，外加一块孤胆英雄般的奶酪。
content.fx.the-festival.done.6.narrate: 凯蒂尔的三只山羊在主街的羊圈里看庆典，嚼草嚼得正合着乐声的拍子。
content.fx.the-festival.done.7.narrate: 凯蒂尔的两只山羊在主街的圈里看庆典。凯蒂尔看着它们，没看烟花。
content.fx.the-festival.done.9.narrate: 整场致辞，三只山羊都站在舞台上，将军还吃掉了讲稿的一页。
content.fx.the-fox.done.2.respawn.0.narrate: 你在广场对面客栈酒馆的长凳上醒了过来。
content.fx.the-fox.done.3.narrate: 正午了。广场上海达摇着一只手铃（这可不是庆典的钟），喊大家傍晚都回舞台来。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.1.narrate: 狐狸叼着钥匙在窝前坐下，看着你，好像不讲理的是你。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.2.respawn.0: 你在城堡大门外的路上醒了过来，门楼把你和庭院隔开。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.3.answers.n: 一堆冷着的柴火，码好了等着。等有人走到城门口，就会把它点起来。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.3.rest_tool: 在火边歇一歇：要是在城堡里倒下，你会在这里醒来。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.fetch-the-fireworks.0.outc: 你把城堡库房里的烟花一支不落地搬了出来。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.fetch-the-fireworks.2.narr: 库房里的烟花一直堆到房梁。等到了广场上，本特会说一声“哦，太好了”，那语气分明是早就不抱希望了。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.find-the-note.0.narrate: 管家的字条，字挤得密密麻麻：“致守夜人，我不在时：城墙上的烽火要按一家人起床的顺序点。厨娘起得最早：她的火在厨房塔下城墙步道的尽头。门卫接着起来开城门：他的火在门楼下城墙步道的尽头。然后是管家：我的在远端城墙上靠厨房那一侧的角楼里。领主起得最晚：他的在远端城墙上靠门楼那一侧的角楼里。点错一个，城墙上的火就会全部熄灭。——本”
content.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-1.0.narrate: 狐狸从藏身处窜出来，沿着山路一溜烟往上跑。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-2.0.narrate: 狐狸从藏身处窜出来，沿着山路一溜烟往上跑。

content.fx.the-fox.oc.lift-the-grate.1.narrate: 你回到院子里时，地窖门上的铁栅正被铁链拉起：是第四堆火起了作用。
content.fx.the-fox.ox.fetch-the-fireworks.0.outc: 你赶到库房时已经晚了：一半烟花被送下了山，剩下的引信也被狐狸啃坏了。
content.fx.the-fox.ox.fetch-the-fireworks.1.narr: 等你赶到库房，伯恩特已经让马童把一半烟花搬下山了，最上面那层剩下的引信也被狐狸啃了。那就只有半场烟花了。
content.fx.the-free-traders-cellar.oc.meet-magnh: Magnhild 给你一盏没有玻璃罩的提灯——会里当年的暗号——又从糖罐里摸出三枚节日便士。“你们这帮人，现在都是会员了。九个人一直是正好的数。十个更好。”
content.fx.the-free-traders.oc.find-the-cellar.4: 账架上那本比别的都塞得深的账簿，在你手下咔哒一声陷了进去，隔壁布料间里有什么沉东西倒了。墙角原本竖着一匹棕布的地方，地板上露出一个方洞，一架梯子通往下面，还飘上来一股蜡烛味。底下有人在唱歌，唱得很难听，唱的是一条不点灯的船。
content.fx.the-goats.oc.pen-the-goats.0.outcome: 你把三只山羊都领进了羊圈，落下了门闩。
content.fx.the-goats.oc.pen-the-goats.2.narrate: 凯蒂尔数了两遍，又数了第三遍。“珍珠。大麦。将军。”他用两只手握住你的手使劲摇。
content.fx.the-goats.ox.pen-the-goats.0.outcome: 凯蒂尔等不下去，自己把山羊找了回来，顺手把它们撂在了舞台上。
content.fx.the-goats.ox.pen-the-goats.7.narrate: 凯蒂尔不指望你们了，自己提着桶上了山坡，回来时带着三只山羊，脾气一点不剩。羊被他安置在哪儿了，他不肯说。
content.fx.the-iron-man.oc.head-the-iron-man.1.o: 你给托瓦尔找来了一个雕好的南瓜，他的铁人有了脑袋。
content.fx.the-iron-man.oc.head-the-iron-man.2.n: 托瓦尔把南瓜在手里转了一圈，点了一下头，把它拿进了里屋。传来一声长长的、慢慢的哐当声。“他看得见了。现在只差唤醒他，而唤醒是要钱的：付我五便士，黄昏时他就和你们一起站在广场上。”
content.fx.the-iron-man.oc.wake-the-iron-man.2.o: 你付钱让托瓦尔唤醒了他的铁人，黄昏时它和你们一起站在广场上。
content.fx.the-iron-man.oc.wake-the-iron-man.3.n: 托瓦尔看都没看就把铜板揣进兜里。“木炭。风箱。我一礼拜的觉。太阳落山时，他会在广场上。”
content.fx.the-lamp.done.3.narrate: 英嘉的声音顺着楼梯井传上来：“既然上去了，就用我的望远镜看看。城堡山路上一上午都不太平。”
content.fx.the-lamp.oc.light-the-lamp.0.outcome: 你点亮了大灯，光柱扫过整片海湾。
content.fx.the-lamp.oc.light-the-lamp.2.narrate: 灯亮了，光束扫过海湾。远远在下面的英嘉欢呼了一声，然后装作没出过声。
你在黄昏前骑着苔苔回到了马厩院子；露娜在广场上看了烟花。
苔苔慢悠悠走进马厩院子，好像哪儿都没去过。露娜拍拍她的脖子，一句话也没说。
content.fx.the-nisse-hall.oc.meet-the-nisse.2.na: 家精在桌子底下摸了一阵，递过来一顶补了又补的帽子。“拿着。算是谢那块黄油。那黄油不错。”
content.fx.the-nisse.oc.feed-the-nisse.5.narrate: 粥刚倒进碗里，碗就空了。碗旁草料隔间里的一捆干草自己滚到了一边，底下的地板上有个洞，洞里架着梯子。下面不知哪儿传来一个又小又不耐烦的声音：“怎么？下来吧。把脚擦干净。”
content.fx.the-pig-race.oc.run-the-pig-race.0.na: 奥斯卡用粉笔把名次写上告示板，舔了舔粉笔，宣布真正的赢家是那些猪。
content.fx.the-pig-race.oc.take-the-dare.7.narra: 奥斯卡的车载着你们一路颠簸，穿过小巷来到草场小路，赛猪已经备好鞍排成一排。车夫乌拉早就骑在她那头上，咧着嘴笑。全镇的人都跑到赛道边上看热闹。
content.fx.the-pig-race.oc.take-the-dare.9.narra: 骑上猪，比赛就开始。把胡萝卜伸到它前面来掌方向。每个检查点都按顺序算：漏了一个就得回去补。
content.fx.trig.belfry-shot.1.narrate: 咚。靶子上的绳结跳了一下。
content.fx.trig.cake-taken.1.outcome: 一个掠夺者冲上了舞台，掠夺者们把奥斯卡的蛋糕和整桌宴席都抢到了海上。
content.fx.trig.cake-taken.3.narrate: 一个掠夺者跳上舞台，从桌上一把抢走奥斯卡的蛋糕，转眼就没了影。海湾里号角一响：掠夺者们高举着蛋糕奔回船上，连宴席的桌子也一起搬走了。

content.fx.trig.find-croft.0.narrate: 小农庄院子里的一只母鸡正对着你下了个蛋，瞧着你，好像你该大为惊叹似的，然后扬长而去。
content.fx.trig.find-dune-cottage.0.narrate: 沙丘小屋门口挂着一串贝壳风铃。有一枚掉进了沙里。贴在耳边，它在嗡嗡作响。
content.fx.trig.find-games-yard.0.narrate: 游戏场篱笆后面有一筐没人看着的节日彩球。朝朋友扔一个吧。
content.fx.trig.find-lantern-yard.0.narrate: 灯笼场里有一盏做好的灯笼，里面钻进了一只飞蛾，怎么也不肯出来。做灯笼的人说，这盏你干脆拿走吧。
content.fx.trig.find-lookout.0.narrate: 瞭望台岩缝里卡着一支避雨的黄铜望远镜，不知是谁很久以前留下的。整座镇子都在镜筒里，还有一只睡在屋顶上的猫。
content.fx.trig.find-net-green.0.narrate: 晾着的渔网里缠着一只漂流瓶，里面有张字条，字迹圆润工整：“捡到这个的人：海鸥们在密谋什么。”
content.fx.trig.find-poi-hut.0.narrate: 牧人小屋里，一口锅挂在压着的余火上，旁边有张字条：“请自便。别碰山羊。”
content.fx.trig.find-terrace-cottage.0.narrate: 梯田小屋里谁家的奶奶从窗口探出身，塞给你一小纸包：三块饼干，还热乎着，过节吃的。
content.fx.trig.find-west-orchard.0.narrate: 梯田果园里最老的那棵树顶上，有一个苹果是金的。它掉进你手里，像是一直在等你。
content.fx.trig.fire-cook.1.narrate: 火点着了：厨娘的烽火在城墙上燃了起来。
content.fx.trig.fire-cook.9.narrate: 顺序错了！火苗猛地扑到你脸上，城墙上所有的烽火都熄灭了。
content.fx.trig.fire-lord.1.narrate: 火点着了：领主的烽火在城墙上燃了起来。
content.fx.trig.fire-lord.11.narrate: 顺序错了！火苗猛地扑到你脸上，城墙上所有的烽火都熄灭了。
content.fx.trig.fire-lord.4.narrate: 第四堆烽火燃起，墙里的铁链哗啦啦地响向地窖门。
content.fx.trig.fire-porter.1.narrate: 火点着了：门卫的烽火在城墙上燃了起来。
content.fx.trig.fire-porter.9.narrate: 顺序错了！火苗猛地扑到你脸上，城墙上所有的烽火都熄灭了。
content.fx.trig.fire-steward.1.narrate: 火点着了：管家的烽火在城墙上燃了起来。
content.fx.trig.fire-steward.9.narrate: 顺序错了！火苗猛地扑到你脸上，城墙上所有的烽火都熄灭了。
content.fx.trig.garrison-wakes.1.narrate: 城墙里传来旧铁甲哐啷作响，还有本不该站起来的东西咯吱起身的声音：城堡的老守军，正在院子里站起来。
content.fx.trig.gate-bell.0.narrate: 钟声当当地传下山去，车夫的马车沿着山路咯噔咯噔地上来了。站在路上的人都坐车下到了广场。
content.fx.trig.grate-shut.0.narrate: 铁栅抬不起来。它的铁链钻进墙里，一直通到城墙上的烽火。本特说过，他的字条在井边他的箱子里。
content.fx.trig.inn-bell.0.narrate: 铃声在院子里当当作响，车夫扬鞭催马。站在院子里的人都坐上车，一路上山到了城堡大门口。
content.fx.trig.pen-admiral.2.narrate: 海军上将进圈了，在干草架旁安顿下来，好像从没离开过。
content.fx.trig.pen-barley.2.narrate: 大麦进圈了，在干草架旁安顿下来，好像从没离开过。
content.fx.trig.pen-pearl.2.narrate: 珍珠进圈了，在干草架旁安顿下来，好像从没离开过。
content.fx.trig.porridge-pot.1.narrate: 干草上搁着一口盖着的锅，还温着：里面是粥，上头一块黄油正在化开，还有一把长柄勺。你盛了一碗。
content.fx.trig.race-start.2.narrate: 奥斯卡把围裙一扔，猪就冲出去了。乌拉欢呼一声，跟着冲了出去。
content.fx.trig.ring-for-glow.4.narrate: 钟声轰鸣，镇上每个掠夺者都像灯笼一样亮了起来。
content.fx.trig.runa-runs.1.outcome: 你骗露娜去看她姐姐家那头根本没在下崽的牛，趁她不在牵走了苔苔。
content.fx.trig.runa-runs.4.narrate: 露娜扔下刷子就跑。广场边的拴马桩旁，配好鞍的苔苔饶有兴致地看着你。
content.fx.trig.scarecrow-allotments-strike.0.na: 这是稻草人的脑袋，不是做灯笼的南瓜。做灯笼的在堆肥旁边的桶里。
content.fx.trig.scarecrow-allotments-use.0.narra: 这是稻草人的脑袋，不是做灯笼的南瓜。做灯笼的在堆肥旁边的桶里。
那个南瓜是稻草人的脑袋。没了它，他可就太滑稽了。别动它。
content.fx.trig.scarecrow-kitchen-garden-use.0.n: 那个南瓜是稻草人的脑袋。没了它，他可就太滑稽了。别动它。
content.fx.trig.scarecrow-wheat-field-strike.0.n: 那个南瓜是稻草人的脑袋，连乌鸦都知道。别动它。
content.fx.trig.scarecrow-wheat-field-use.0.narr: 那个南瓜是稻草人的脑袋，连乌鸦都知道。别动它。
content.fx.trig.spot-the-fox.1.narrate: 望远镜里：城堡山路上，一只狐狸叼着亮闪闪的东西往山上小跑。英嘉在楼梯下眯着眼往上喊：“那是伯恩特的库房钥匙。烟花全锁在里面。”
content.fx.trig.take-the-key.2.narrate: 狐狸打量了你好一会儿，才张开嘴让你把钥匙拿走。它看起来很受伤。

content.obj.dusk.back-to-the-stage.hint: 沿主街上到广场的舞台，海达正盯着海面。告诉她之前先准备好：去托瓦尔的柜台买铁器，把包装满，把镇上给你们的东西都带上。号角一响，镇上别的事都得等这场掠夺结束。
content.obj.dusk.back-to-the-stage.record: 黄昏时分，海达把全镇的人都叫回了舞台前。
content.obj.dusk.back-to-the-stage.title: 迎战掠夺者
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-beach.hint: 从灯塔那边沿崖边小路过来，正穿过最后一条小巷往上走。
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-beach.record: 第二批强盗在港口边的沙滩上了岸。
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-beach.title: 击退海滩登陆
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-dock.hint: 沿主街往下朝码头去：从船上上来的掠夺者。
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-dock.record: 黄昏时强盗在码头登岸，顺着主街冲着庆典来了。
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-dock.title: 击退码头登陆
content.obj.dusk.stop-the-captain.hint: 从码头沿主街上来：船长和他最后的进攻。
content.obj.dusk.stop-the-captain.record: 海鸥船长最后上岸，带着他的精兵沿主街杀上来，直奔蛋糕。
content.obj.dusk.stop-the-captain.title: 拦住船长
content.obj.opening.hear-the-host.hint: 广场上的舞台，就在大教堂正门旁边。
content.obj.opening.hear-the-host.record: 主持人海达在广场的舞台上宣布庆典开幕。
content.obj.opening.hear-the-host.title: 听主持人讲话
content.obj.the-bell.ask-vidar.hint: 主街最上头，广场下面一点：拿着弓的那位书记员。
content.obj.the-bell.ask-vidar.record: 公会厅的书记维达敲不了庆典的钟：钟绳断了，绳结挂在钟楼的靶子上。
content.obj.the-bell.ask-vidar.title: 找书记员谈谈
content.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.answers.not_y: 铛的一声闷响。绳结还卡在钟楼上。
content.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.hint: 站在主街顶端，往钟楼开口里的标靶射三箭。然后去教堂前院敲钟。
content.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.record: 往钟楼的靶子上射中三箭，就能把绳结震下来，钟才能敲响。
content.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.title: 射钟楼的靶子
content.obj.the-cargo.ask-sverre.hint: 沿主街下到码头，在滑道旁边。
content.obj.the-cargo.ask-sverre.record: 造船匠斯韦勒的货船在沙洲上翻了，宴席的六只货箱漂得满小海湾都是。
content.obj.the-cargo.ask-sverre.title: 和造船匠说话
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-1.hint: 从码头下的滑道划出去，找到港口那一侧第一道沙洲的后面那只货箱，坐在船上把它打开。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-1.record: 宴席的第一只货箱漂在港口那一侧第一道沙洲的后面，漂不了多久。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-1.title: 捞起一只货箱
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-2.hint: 从码头下的滑道划出去，找到浅滩正中的那片潟湖里那只货箱，坐在船上把它打开。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-2.record: 宴席的第二只货箱漂在浅滩正中的那片潟湖里，漂不了多久。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-2.title: 捞起一只货箱
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-3.hint: 从码头下的滑道划出去，找到灯塔那一侧第一道沙洲的后面那只货箱，坐在船上把它打开。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-3.record: 宴席的第三只货箱漂在灯塔那一侧第一道沙洲的后面，漂不了多久。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-3.title: 捞起一只货箱
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-4.hint: 从码头下的滑道划出去，找到外沙洲里侧、靠灯塔那边那只货箱，坐在船上把它打开。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-4.record: 宴席的第四只货箱漂在外沙洲里侧、靠灯塔那边，漂不了多久。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-4.title: 捞起一只货箱
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-5.hint: 从码头下的滑道划出去，找到外沙洲外头、水道口边上那只货箱，坐在船上把它打开。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-5.record: 宴席的第五只货箱漂在外沙洲外头、水道口边上，漂不了多久。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-5.title: 捞起一只货箱
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-6.hint: 从码头下的滑道划出去，找到外沙洲外头、靠灯塔那边那只货箱，坐在船上把它打开。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-6.record: 宴席的第六只货箱漂在外沙洲外头、靠灯塔那边，漂不了多久。
content.obj.the-cargo.crate-6.title: 捞起一只货箱
content.obj.the-cargo.land-the-cargo.hint: 从滑道走回码头，沿码头到港口小屋，斯韦勒正在那儿清点。
content.obj.the-cargo.land-the-cargo.record: 从海湾里救回来的货箱要运到港口小屋，交给斯韦勒清点。
content.obj.the-cargo.land-the-cargo.title: 把货物运上岸
content.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.answers.done: 皮普在上层池塘安了家，头也不回。
content.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.answers.missi: 上面的池子在等皮普。拿着装皮普的桶，在这儿倒进去。
content.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.answers.not_y: 一圈长满苔藓的池沿，围着一汪静静的小池。会有个小家伙喜欢这里的。
content.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.hint: 沿洞穴深处长满苔藓的台阶上去：拿着装皮普的桶，对上层池塘长满苔藓的池沿使用。
content.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.title: 把皮普送上去
content.obj.the-cat-cave.follow-the-cat.hint: 猫小跑着去了大教堂后面的山丘：穿过大教堂花园的另一头，沿着山脚的小路，走到一个挂满苔藓的洞口。
content.obj.the-cat-cave.follow-the-cat.record: 猫带路去了一个繁茂的洞穴，她的朋友、精通鱼类的美西螈皮普想搬到上面的池子去。
content.obj.the-cat-cave.follow-the-cat.title: 跟着猫
content.obj.the-cat-cave.meet-pip.hint: 洞里，下层池塘边，猫坐着的地方。
content.obj.the-cat-cave.meet-pip.title: 猫的朋友
content.obj.the-cat-cave.scoop-pip.hint: 在洞里的下层池塘：拿着水桶对粉色的美西螈皮普使用。
content.obj.the-cat-cave.scoop-pip.title: 舀起皮普
content.obj.the-cat-den.down-to-the-den.hint: 在小屋的里角：顺着活板门下的梯子下去，沿着岩架走，再过桥到对面。
content.obj.the-cat-den.down-to-the-den.title: 穿过深渊
content.obj.the-cat-den.follow-the-cat-home.hint: 猫一路小跑上了城堡路：在城堡前最后一个弯道，一条小路穿过高地，通往一间老矿工小屋。
content.obj.the-cat-den.follow-the-cat-home.reco: 猫终于让步了，带路去了她的窝，那窝在城堡底下一道深渊的另一头。
content.obj.the-cat-rounds.ask-the-cat-1.record: 猫坐在洞口晒太阳，谁也别想打扰它。
content.obj.the-cat.catch-cod.hint: 用猫给的旧钓竿在鸭塘钓鱼，直到手里有五条鳕鱼。鲑鱼什么的不算：猫要的是鳕鱼。
content.obj.the-cat.catch-cod.title: 给猫的五条鳕鱼

content.obj.the-cat.feed-the-cat-1.answers.not_y: 猫的五个碗之一。本猫不会平白饿着。先钓鱼。
content.obj.the-cat.feed-the-cat-1.hint: 手里拿着一条鳕鱼，放进池塘岸边猫身旁那排五个碗里的第一个——从离她最远的那头数起。

content.obj.the-cat.meet-the-cat.record: 鸭塘边有只大灰猫想要池子里的五条鳕鱼，而且它会说话。
content.obj.the-cat.meet-the-cat.title: 会说话的猫
content.obj.the-festival.open-the-festival.hint: 广场上的舞台，全镇的人都在那儿等着。
content.obj.the-festival.open-the-festival.recor: 海达在广场上拉开了夜晚庆典的帷幕——白天办成了多少，庆典就是什么样子。
content.obj.the-festival.open-the-festival.title: 请海达开场
content.obj.the-fox.clear-the-yard.hint: 进了城门，就在院子里：城堡的老守军，死了一百年了还在站岗。
content.obj.the-fox.clear-the-yard.record: 城堡的老守军死了一百年，却还守着院子。
content.obj.the-fox.clear-the-yard.title: 击退老守军
content.obj.the-fox.corner-the-fox.hint: 城堡山路的尽头，城门旁边：门前路堤下的狐狸窝。
content.obj.the-fox.corner-the-fox.record: 狐狸叼着钥匙，跑回了城堡大门边土坡下的窝。
content.obj.the-fox.corner-the-fox.title: 把狐狸堵住
content.obj.the-fox.fetch-the-fireworks.hint: 穿过升起的铁栅，进到大厅底下的酒桶地窖：管家的箱子就在酒桶中间。
content.obj.the-fox.fetch-the-fireworks.record: 城堡的烟花锁在大厅下面的库房里，得赶在管家放弃之前取出来。
content.obj.the-fox.fetch-the-fireworks.title: 取出烟花
content.obj.the-fox.find-the-note.hint: 城堡院子里，井边：管家的箱子。
content.obj.the-fox.find-the-note.record: 管家的字条写明了城墙上烽火的顺序：先是厨房塔下厨娘的，再是门楼下门卫的，然后是远端城墙的两座角楼，靠厨房一侧是管家的，靠门楼一侧是领主的。
content.obj.the-fox.find-the-note.title: 找到管家的字条
content.obj.the-fox.flush-1.hint: 从广场沿城堡山路往上，到路边的泉水那儿。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-1.record: 一只狐狸叼走了城堡烟花库房的钥匙，躲到了城堡山路边的泉水旁。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-1.title: 找到狐狸
content.obj.the-fox.flush-2.hint: 沿城堡山路继续往上，到路边的蜂园，狐狸跑到那儿去了。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-2.record: 狐狸顺着城堡山路往上跑，躲进了蜂园。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-2.title: 追狐狸
content.obj.the-fox.flush-3.hint: 沿城堡山路继续往上，到路边的牧人小屋，狐狸跑到那儿去了。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-3.record: 狐狸顺着城堡山路往上跑，躲到了牧人小屋。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-3.title: 追狐狸
content.obj.the-fox.flush-4.hint: 沿城堡山路继续往上，到路边的瞭望台，狐狸跑到那儿去了。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-4.record: 狐狸顺着城堡山路往上跑，躲到了瞭望台。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-4.title: 追狐狸
content.obj.the-fox.lift-the-grate.hint: 按管家字条上的顺序点燃城堡城墙步道上的四堆烽火，然后回到院子里的地窖铁栅前。城墙步道要从门楼旁边沿城墙上去的台阶上去。
content.obj.the-fox.lift-the-grate.record: 地窖的铁栅只会为城墙上的四堆烽火升起，要按管家字条上的顺序点。
content.obj.the-fox.lift-the-grate.title: 回到地窖铁栅前
content.obj.the-free-traders-cellar.meet-magnhil: 顺着布料间角落的梯子下去，在牌桌旁。
自由商人会的最后一人 Magnhild 说出了六十一年前创会的是谁：那个划小船的姑娘，如今就坐在节日的前排。
content.obj.the-free-traders.find-the-cellar.ans: 那本塞进去的账簿就那么塞着，不再动了。
商人的账簿：一栏一栏的数字，没有一本是给你看的。
content.obj.the-free-traders.find-the-cellar.rec: 商人的布料间里，一匹布后面藏着一架梯子，通往 Kelderby 自由商人会的地窖。
content.obj.the-goats.ask-kettil.hint: 主街走到一半，空着的羊圈那儿。
content.obj.the-goats.ask-kettil.record: 箍桶匠凯蒂尔的三只山羊跑出了主街上的羊圈，溜上了山坡。
content.obj.the-goats.ask-kettil.title: 和箍桶匠说话
content.obj.the-goats.gather-wheat.hint: 沿着造船匠家旁边的侧街往下，再顺着农场小路走出去，就是麦田。
content.obj.the-goats.gather-wheat.record: 山羊会跟着小麦走，小麦在农场小路那头的麦田里。
content.obj.the-goats.gather-wheat.title: 拿小麦
content.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.answers.done: 门闩落下。三只山羊满腹狐疑地盯着你。
content.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.answers.not_: 还不行：得先让三只山羊都进圈。
content.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.hint: 用麦子把凯蒂尔的三只山羊引回主街半路上他的羊圈，一只一只来或一起来都行，然后放下门闩。一只在梯田上的果园里：顺着主街下到鱼铺，穿过它的后院上梯田小路，沿路走到小路上方的果园。一只在路边泉那儿，就是从广场上城堡路的第一站。那只老公羊在农场小道尽头的果园里：沿着羊圈旁边的五号巷走，顺小道过了池塘就到。
content.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.record: 得在黄昏前把凯蒂尔的三只山羊领回羊圈，闩上门。
content.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.title: 把山羊关进圈
content.obj.the-iron-man.find-a-pumpkin.hint: 码头尽头再往前，菜园里刻灯笼的人的木桶。
content.obj.the-iron-man.find-a-pumpkin.record: 刻灯笼的人在菜园的木桶里放着雕好的南瓜。
content.obj.the-iron-man.find-a-pumpkin.title: 找一个雕好的南瓜
content.obj.the-iron-man.head-the-iron-man.answe: 铁人的脑袋已经装好了。托瓦尔不让你碰。
托瓦尔敲了敲铁砧。“脑袋放这儿。要是你找到了，一个雕好的南瓜。”
托瓦尔摆摆手。“现在不行。宴席的货箱靠岸之前，码头那边每双手都得用上。”
content.obj.the-iron-man.head-the-iron-man.recor: 托瓦尔的铁人缺一个雕好的南瓜当脑袋。
content.obj.the-iron-man.wake-the-iron-man.hint: 主街上铁匠铺里的托瓦尔：黄昏前付 5 便士。
content.obj.the-iron-man.wake-the-iron-man.recor: 只要五便士，托瓦尔就会在黄昏前唤醒他的铁人。
content.obj.the-iron-man.wake-the-iron-man.title: 请托瓦尔唤醒铁人
content.obj.the-lamp.ask-inga.hint: 沿主街往下，在最后一条小巷左转，顺着崖边小路走到白色灯塔。
content.obj.the-lamp.ask-inga.record: 守塔人英嘉需要有人替她爬上灯塔：夜里灯灭了。
content.obj.the-lamp.ask-inga.title: 找守塔人谈谈
content.obj.the-lamp.climb-the-tower.hint: 沿塔内楼梯往上：台阶断了的地方，跳过去。
content.obj.the-lamp.climb-the-tower.record: 通往灯室的楼梯有三处塌了。
content.obj.the-lamp.climb-the-tower.title: 爬上灯室
content.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.hint: 塔顶的灯室里：正中间那盏大灯。
content.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.record: 灯塔的灯得在晚上的船回港前重新点亮。
content.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.title: 点亮大灯
content.obj.the-mare-home.bring-back-the-mare.hi: 黄昏前，骑着苔苔从广场边的车道进到旅店的马厩院子。
content.obj.the-mare-home.bring-back-the-mare.re: 黄昏前得把苔苔骑回旅店的马厩院子。
content.obj.the-mare.take-the-mare.record: 从旅店马厩借来露娜的灰母马苔苔，黄昏前送回去。
content.obj.the-mare.take-the-mare.title: 借灰母马
content.obj.the-nisse-hall.meet-the-nisse.hint: 顺着谷仓里那捆干草下面的梯子下去。
content.obj.the-nisse-hall.meet-the-nisse.record: 被欠了三年粥的农场家精承认，每逢节日早上放走 Kettil 山羊的就是他，并答应从此收手。
content.obj.the-nisse-hall.meet-the-nisse.title: 农场的主人
content.obj.the-nisse.feed-the-nisse.answers.don: 小碗刮得干干净净。有人很喜欢。
content.obj.the-nisse.feed-the-nisse.answers.mis: 草料隔间旁的地上放着一只小陶碗，舔得干干净净。旁边的地板上刻着字：粥，上面放黄油。别再忘了。
content.obj.the-nisse.feed-the-nisse.answers.not: 草料隔间旁的地上放着一只小陶碗，舔得干干净净。旁边的地板上刻着字：粥，上面放黄油。别再忘了。
content.obj.the-nisse.feed-the-nisse.record: 照碗边地板上刻的字，在农庄谷仓里留下一碗粥，就打开了通往农场家精的路。
content.obj.the-nisse.feed-the-nisse.title: 空碗
content.obj.the-pig-race.run-the-pig-race.hint: 在集市场旁边草场小路的起跑线上骑上猪，按顺序跑过赛道上的每个检查点：穿过农场后面的树林往上，经过大教堂的花园和墓园，从大教堂侧门进、正门大门出到广场，沿主街往下，顺着下面那条小巷经过游戏场，再冲过终点线。
content.obj.the-pig-race.run-the-pig-race.record: 猪赛绕全镇一圈，穿过大教堂再跑回来，对手是一个叫乌拉的车夫。
content.obj.the-pig-race.run-the-pig-race.title: 骑猪比赛
content.obj.the-pig-race.take-the-dare.hint: 主街上头的面包房门口：奥斯卡养着庆典的赛猪，谁敢比他就跟谁比。
content.obj.the-pig-race.take-the-dare.record: 面包师奥斯卡养着庆典的赛猪，谁敢来，就跟谁绕全镇赛一场。
content.obj.the-pig-race.take-the-dare.title: 奥斯卡的猪赛
content.quest.dusk.goal: 黄昏回到舞台，把三拨登陆的掠夺者赶出庆典。
content.quest.opening.goal: 听主持人在舞台上宣布庆典开幕，然后听着所有事一齐出岔子。
content.quest.the-bell.goal: 用三支箭把卡在钟楼标靶上的断绳结射下来，再敲响庆典的钟。
content.quest.the-cargo.goal: 划着造船匠的船出海湾，绕开浅滩，趁宴席的六只货箱还没漂走，把它们一只只倒进船里——其中两只漂到了沙洲外面——再运回港口。
content.quest.the-cat-cave.goal: 跟着猫去大教堂后山的繁茂洞穴，用桶把她的朋友——美西螈皮普——送到洞里上层的池塘。
content.quest.the-cat-den.goal: 跟着猫沿城堡路上山去老矿工小屋，从地板底下下到城堡下面的深渊，过桥去她的窝。
content.quest.the-cat-rounds.goal: 缠着坐在洞口的猫，一遍遍问它还有没有别处值得一看，直到它让步。
content.quest.the-cat.goal: 为会说话的猫从鸭塘钓五条鳕鱼，放进她的碗里。
content.quest.the-festival.goal: 在夜里办起庆典，白天办成了什么，庆典就是什么样子。
content.quest.the-fox.goal: 沿城堡山路追着狐狸从一个藏身处到下一个，一直追到它的窝，再及时从城堡库房取出烟花。
content.quest.the-free-traders-cellar.goal: 顺着布料间里的暗梯下到走私者的地窖，听自由商人会的最后一人 Magnhild 讲出创会的是谁。
content.quest.the-free-traders.goal: 找出商人账房里那排账架藏着什么。
content.quest.the-goats.goal: 黄昏前从侧翼的麦田拿到小麦，把凯蒂尔的三只山羊从梯田、城堡山路边的泉水和农场果园引回主街上他的羊圈，再放下门闩。
content.quest.the-iron-man.goal: 给铁匠托瓦尔找一个雕好的南瓜当铁人的脑袋，再付钱请他在黄昏时叫醒它。
content.quest.the-lamp.goal: 爬上楼梯断了几处的灯塔，把灯点亮。
content.quest.the-mare-home.goal: 黄昏前把露娜的灰母马骑回旅店的马厩院子。
content.quest.the-mare.goal: 从旅店马厩借来露娜的灰母马——用铜板租，或者耍个花招牵走。
content.quest.the-nisse-hall.goal: 从农庄谷仓那捆干草底下下去找农场的家精，听他说山羊为什么会跑出去。
content.quest.the-nisse.goal: 弄清楚农庄谷仓里那只空碗在等什么。
content.quest.the-pig-race.goal: 骑奥斯卡的猪绕镇比赛：穿过农场后面的树林往上，从侧门进、正门出穿过大教堂，沿主街往下，再顺着下面那条小巷回到终点线。

source.cast.the-festival.agathe.0.bark.0: Sixty-one festivals, and every one of them went wrong somewhere. That is how you know it is the festival.
source.cast.the-festival.bernt.0.bark.0: The fireworks are in the castle cellar, behind the old grate. My note is in my chest by the well. I am not going up there again.
source.cast.the-festival.inga.0.bark.0: Mind the stairs. The stairs do not mind you.
source.cast.the-festival.kettil.0.bark.0: Three goats in the pen and a festival on the square. A good day.
source.cast.the-festival.kettil.1.bark.0: Two goats in the pen tonight. Still two goats.
source.cast.the-festival.kettil.2.bark.0: Do not ask me where the goats are. You will see.
source.cast.the-festival.kettil.3.bark.0: Three goats, and one of them is the problem.
source.cast.the-festival.oskar.0.bark.0: The cake is resting. Do not slam any doors near the cake.
source.cast.the-festival.runa.0.bark.0: Moss! Moss! Has anybody seen a grey mare?
source.cast.the-festival.runa.1.bark.0: The mare is resting. Mares rest. That is what mares do.
source.cast.the-festival.runa.2.bark.0: The mare is resting. Mares rest. That is what mares do.
source.cast.the-festival.sverre.0.bark.0: Six crates of the feast in the bay. Row gently. Crates are shy.
source.cast.the-festival.torvald.0.bark.0: A holiday. The forge is cold. I do not know what to do with my hands.
source.cast.the-festival.vidar.0.bark.0: By-law fourteen: the bell rings at dusk. By-law fourteen did not foresee the rope.

source.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.0.label: Is the castle very old?
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.1.label: Anything worth seeing?
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.2.label: The tide is out.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.3.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.text: My dear, I have watched sixty-one of these festivals and every one of them nearly did not happen. Go on. I shall be in the front row tonight.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-legend.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-legend.text: Older. My husband's family swore the old lords hid their finest arms somewhere in it before the last siege, and never came back for them. Forty years I lived up there, and found nothing but draughts and a garrison that would not lie down, so I came down to the town. Perhaps it is true. Nobody knows how one would get at it, if it were.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-sights.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-sights.text: If the hills are too much for your legs, Runa at the inn's stable hires out her grey mare. And Torvald the smith sells good iron at his counter on the main street, for the pennies the town is handing out. When I was a girl there was a cave in the hill behind the cathedral, all green and glowing. I expect it is still there.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tide.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tide.text: Lady Agathe goes very still. Then she laughs, a girl's laugh, much too loud for the front row. 'Magnhild! That impossible child. She still has the cellar? Of course she does.' She lowers her voice. 'Eleven pounds a year, for sixty-one years, and Oskar has never once asked where it came from. Good man, Oskar. Not a word to Vidar Foss, mind. He would have to look up the by-law, and it would spoil his whole night.'
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.opt.0.label: And the castle?
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.opt.1.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.text: A fox. In MY storeroom. With MY key. And now it is off up the road with it, and the fireworks are locked in until somebody catches it. I would go myself, but I do not go up to the castle any more. Not since the garrison started getting up again.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-fox.opt.0.label: We'll manage.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-fox.text: So the fox has been seen. When you have the key, mind the castle: the old garrison gets up in the yard when it is quiet, and they do not know they are dead. The fireworks are in the cellar under the great hall, behind the old grate, and the grate lifts only for the four watch fires in the yard, lit in the proper order. I wrote the order down and left the note in my chest by the well. Light one out of turn and the lot go out.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-legend.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-legend.text: Ghost stories. Lady Agathe's family say there is a treasure of the old lords somewhere in it. Forty years I have swept that castle, and if there is, it is better hidden than my storeroom key.
source.dlg.cat.cat-asks.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.cat.cat-asks.text: 'The cat talks when there is something worth saying. Here it is. There are cod in this pond. Five, please. Cod, not salmon. Not the little striped ones either: those are a different matter, and not for today. Use the rod. Put them in the dish. The cat will be grateful, in its way.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.0.label: We'll carry Pip up.
source.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.0.tooltip: Scoop Pip up in a bucket and carry him to the upper pond.
source.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.1.label: Hello, Pip.
source.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.2.label: Thousands of what?
source.dlg.cat.cat-cave.opt.3.label: Goodbye, cat.
source.dlg.cat.cat-cave.text: The cave is green and dripping and lit by glowing berries. The cat sits by the lower pond beside a small pink axolotl. 'This is Pip. Pip knows fish. All of them. The little striped ones especially, and there are thousands of kinds of those, and the cat... never mind what the cat. Pip wants the upper pond, where the light is. The cat cannot carry a bucket. You can.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-home.opt.0.label: What is that thing?
source.dlg.cat.cat-home.opt.1.label: Thank you, cat.
source.dlg.cat.cat-home.text: The cat sits by the old miner's hut, washing a paw. 'The cat's den is the cat's. What is in the chest is yours now. The cat has no more use for it: the cat has retired. Mostly.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.0.label: Anywhere else to see?
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.0.tooltip: Is there anywhere else interesting you could show me?
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.1.label: Just one more place?
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.1.tooltip: Just one more place? Anywhere at all?
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.2.label: You know every corner.
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.2.tooltip: You know every corner of this town, don't you?
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.3.label: I'll find you a salmon.
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.3.tooltip: Please? I'll find you a salmon.
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.4.label: I'm not leaving.
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.4.tooltip: I'm not leaving until you show me.
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.opt.5.label: Sleep well, cat.
source.dlg.cat.cat-mouth.text: The cat lies in the sun at the cave mouth with her eyes closed and her tail over her nose. One ear turns toward you.
source.dlg.cat.cat-pip.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.cat.cat-pip.text: Pip looks up at you and smiles, as axolotls do. 'A friend of hers? Then listen. A Kob, white on red, is not a Kob, red on white. Nobody listens. She listens. Two hundred and eleven kinds she has studied with me, and not one of them muddled.' The cat looks at the ceiling.
source.dlg.cat.cat-pond.opt.0.label: Did you just talk?
source.dlg.cat.cat-pond.opt.0.tooltip: A talking cat. Of course. It is festival day.
source.dlg.cat.cat-pond.opt.1.label: How many cod again?
source.dlg.cat.cat-pond.opt.2.label: Goodbye, cat.
source.dlg.cat.cat-pond.text: A big grey cat with a torn ear is sitting on the bank, watching the pond the way other people watch a door. She turns one eye on you. 'Mrrp. You. You have hands.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-1.opt.0.label: Hm.
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-1.text: 'The cat has eaten. The cat is going to sleep now. Do not bother the cat.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-2.opt.0.label: Hm.
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-2.text: 'The cat is asleep. This is the cat, asleep. Observe the cat sleeping, quietly, somewhere else.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-3.opt.0.label: Hm.
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-3.text: 'The cat knows every corner of eleven harbours, two mountains and one desert. The cat is not telling. The cat is digesting.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-4.opt.0.label: Hm.
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-4.text: 'A salmon. The cat has had salmon, out of a river that runs uphill, in a country you have never heard of. Do not tempt the cat. The cat is asleep.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-5.opt.0.label: Hm.
source.dlg.cat.cat-round-5.text: 'Mrrrrrow. Fine. There is no getting rid of you, is there. One more place. Keep up, and touch nothing that is not yours. Some of it is very sharp.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-thing.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.cat.cat-thing.text: 'The stone one? A likeness, and not a good one. The cat has seen the real one, in another town, far gloomier than this: rain every day, and nobody laughed. It got away.' The cat's whiskers twitch. 'A pity. It would have made a very fine grilled octopus.'
source.dlg.cat.cat-thousands.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.cat.cat-thousands.text: 'Of nothing. Of fish. The cat was making conversation.' The cat washes a paw with great attention. Behind her, Pip blows a bubble that sounds a great deal like a laugh.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.opt.0.label: Anything worth seeing?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.opt.1.label: Smiling.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.text: How is it going? Don't tell me. Tell me at dusk. Smile at the town.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.0.label: We're ready. Let them come.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.0.tooltip: There is no going back: the raid begins at once, and the rest of the town waits until it is over.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.1.label: Not yet.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.2.label: Holding the street!
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.text: You're back! Is it all put right, the lamp and the bell, the goats, the crates, the fireworks? Then look out past the lighthouse, darlings, because I have been looking all afternoon. Striped sails. That is Captain Gull, who comes every year he hears we have a cake worth taking, and this year he has brought friends: big ones. When his horn blows there is no more running about the town: it is this stage, the main street and the cake until it is over. So get ready first. Torvald sells good iron at his counter, and whatever else the town has given you today, bring it.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.0.label: What's that shouting?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.1.label: We'll help.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.1.tooltip: Leave it to us: whatever has gone wrong, we'll put it right before dusk.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.text: Good morning, Kelderby! Good morning, new faces! Today is the festival: a feast on the square, the bell at dusk, the lighthouse lamp over the bay and the castle's fireworks at midnight. Nothing can possibly go wrong.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.opt.0.label: Begin.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.opt.0.tooltip: Open the festival, whatever the day has made of it.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.text: Look at them. Look at all of them. Right. Whatever happened today, that is the festival now. Shall I begin?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-sights.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-sights.text: Oskar's pig race, whenever you dare it: round the whole town on his racing pigs, one rider to a pig, and through the cathedral on the way. Ask him at the bakery's door. And the fair field behind the beach has its stalls out, and every one of them is giving something away. And they do say the big grey cat by the duck pond talks, if it likes you.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-troubles.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-troubles.text: That? That is everything going wrong at once. The boatwright's cargo boat has turned over in the bay with the feast in it. The cooper's goats are up the terraces. The bell rope has snapped. And the lighthouse lamp went out in the night, and the keeper is up there swearing at it. Pick one. Pick all of them. Be back on this stage by dusk.
source.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.opt.0.label: We're going up.
source.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.opt.0.tooltip: Climb the tower and light the lamp.
source.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.text: Went out at three this morning. Wick's fine, oil's fine, the lamp is sulking. Also the stairs gave way in three places on the way up, so you'll be jumping. Light it for me and I'll owe you.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-day.opt.0.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-day.text: If you see a goat anywhere it shouldn't be, it's one of mine.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-gaveup.opt.0.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-gaveup.text: I fetched them myself in the end. They are waiting somewhere you will see tonight, and I am not saying where.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-goats.opt.0.label: We'll bring them home.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-goats.opt.0.tooltip: Fetch wheat from the field and lead the three goats back into this pen.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-goats.text: My three goats are out of the pen. Pearl, the youngest of my nannies, has gone up onto the terraces behind the fishmonger's, into the orchard above the track. Barley, the best milker in Kelderby, is at the wayside spring, a little way up the castle road. And the Admiral, the old billy who undid the latch, is in the orchard out on the farm track. Each of them has a name over its head, and they'll all follow wheat anywhere. The field's out on the farm track.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-herding.opt.0.label: Where are they again?
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-herding.opt.1.label: Anything else today?
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-herding.opt.2.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-herding.text: Hold the wheat up where they can see it and walk slowly. This pen, mind, on the main street: not the sheep's, not the cows'. Once a goat is in here it stays put, so bring them one at a time if you like. When all three are in, drop the latch on the gate.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-lost.opt.0.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-lost.text: I have penned the two that are left. I am not going to talk about the other one today.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-thanks.opt.0.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-thanks.text: All three home and the latch down. Pearl, Barley, the Admiral. I have told them all about you.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-tip.opt.0.label: I'll remember that.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-tip.text: And one more thing. Runa's grey mare? Runa will not lend her without pennies. But if you want her without paying, tell Runa her sister's cow is calving. She would leave a burning stable for that cow. You did not hear it from me.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-where.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-where.text: Pearl is in the orchard on the terraces: down the main street to the fishmonger's, through its back yard onto the terrace track, and along it to the orchard above. Barley is at the wayside spring, the first stop up the castle road from the square. And the Admiral is in the orchard out on the farm track: along lane 5 beside this pen and out past the pond.
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.opt.0.label: What is this place?
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.opt.1.label: What's in the sacks?
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.opt.2.label: Who founded it?
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.opt.3.label: Goodbye, Magnhild.
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-cellar.text: At a card table among the casks an old woman in a sea-coat is playing patience by candlelight, and losing. She does not look up. 'Mind the ladder, shipmate, it bites. Well, well. Eleven years nobody has found the way down. Sit, if you can find a cask that isn't full.'
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-founder.opt.0.tool: Magnhild gives you the society's last share: a lantern with no glass, its old signal, and three pennies.
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-founder.text: 'The girl with the rowing boat?' Magnhild turns over a card and smiles at it. 'She sits in the front row of the festival every year in a green coat, and the whole town calls her Lady. Go and tell her the tide is out. Watch her face when you do.' She pushes something across the table. 'And take the society's share. There's nobody else to give it to.'
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-society.text: 'The Kelderby Free Traders. Smugglers, if you like, and you'll not like it out loud. Founded in this cellar sixty-one years ago, by a girl of nineteen with a rowing boat and no fear of anything. I was twelve. I held the lantern.' She lays a card down on the wrong pile. 'There were nine of us once. There is one. I'm Magnhild, and I'm the one.'
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-sugar.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.magnhild.magnhild-sugar.text: 'Sugar.' She says it the way other people say gold. 'By-law forty-one: no sugar is landed in Kelderby but over the guild's scale, at a penny the ounce. A sugar lighthouse on top of a festival cake takes eleven pounds of it. Do the sum, shipmate. Nobody in this town could pay it. So every year, the week before the festival, eleven pounds come in over the rocks at night in a boat with no lamp, and Oskar finds them on his back step, and he has never once asked.' She pats the nearest sack. 'This year's. The last run. My knees won't do another.'
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-goats.opt.0.label: Will you stop?
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-goats.opt.0.tooltip: Ask the nisse to leave the cooper's goats alone from now on.
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-goats.opt.1.label: Back.
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-goats.text: He puts his spoon down. 'The goats. The cooper's goats, that get out of a shut pen every festival morning and go up the mountain as if they had been invited.' He picks the spoon up again. 'I invited them. A latch is a very simple thing, for some of us. Three years they have gone, and three years nobody thought to wonder why. Well. I have had my porridge now.'
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.opt.0.label: Who are you?
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.opt.1.label: Wonder about what?
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.opt.2.label: What's all this?
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.opt.3.label: Goodbye, Nisse.
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-hall.text: In a hall of roots under the barn, at a table no higher than your knee, a little old man in a red cap is eating porridge as if somebody might take it off him. His beard is in it. 'Three festivals,' he says, not looking up. 'Three festivals, nobody. And then they wonder.'
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-hoard.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-hoard.text: 'Things people dropped and did not come back for. Finders keepers is the oldest law there is, older than the clerk's by-laws.' A pair of spectacles with one lens. A sugar spoon. Forty-one odd socks, sorted by colour. A bell's clapper. 'That is the guildhall's. The clerk has rung his bell with a borrowed clapper for twenty years. Do not tell him: he would want it back.'
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-promise.opt.0.label: Goodbye, Nisse.
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-promise.text: 'Stop? I have stopped. A bargain is a bargain.' He wipes his beard. 'The goats sleep in their pen tonight, and the barn's cows give cream for a week. You may tell the cooper that much. Do not tell him why: he would leave out a saucer of milk, and I am not a cat.'
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-who.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.nisse.nisse-who.text: 'Who am I. Who am I! I am the master of this farm, is who. I was here when the first beam of that barn went up, and the beam knows it. Every calf born up there, I sat up with. Every hen, I counted. One bowl of porridge a year, on festival eve, butter on top: that was the bargain, and it was kept for three hundred years. Your great-great-grandmother kept it. She had better manners than you, and you have not even sat down.'
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.opt.0.label: A pig race?
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.opt.1.label: Anything worth seeing?
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.opt.2.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.text: The cake is done. Four tiers, candied cherries, a sugar lighthouse on top. It goes on the stage at dusk and nobody breathes on it until midnight.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-race.opt.0.label: We'll race.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-race.opt.0.tooltip: Oskar's cart takes the whole party down to the start line, wherever each of you is, and the race is on: the rest of the day waits until it has been run.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-race.opt.1.label: Back.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-race.text: My racing pigs! Saddled since dawn and eating their heads off. Round the whole town: up through the woods behind the farms, through the cathedral garden and the churchyard, in at the cathedral's side door and out at its great front door, down the main street and home along the lower lane to the meadow track. Every checkpoint on the way, in order, or it does not count. A carter called Ulla has won it three years running and will not stop saying so. Race her?
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-sights.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-sights.text: My counter sells bread and pie for the town's pennies, even today. And if it is honey you want, the bee meadow behind the beach: the hives are full, and there are bottles in the honey stand for whoever fills them. The lookout up the castle road has the best view in Kelderby; people leave things up there.
source.dlg.runa.runa-day.opt.0.label: Good day to you.
source.dlg.runa.runa-day.opt.1.label: Your sister's cow is calving!
source.dlg.runa.runa-day.opt.1.tooltip: Kettil's tip: send Runa off up the farm track to her sister's calving cow, and take the mare while she is gone.
source.dlg.runa.runa-day.text: Moss is in the back stable. She can be hired, at the barrel there, for pennies, which the town is handing out today to anyone who mends something. She is not for running down the main street with.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-cargo.opt.0.label: We'll row out.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-cargo.opt.0.tooltip: Take Sverre's boat out into the bay and bring the crates in.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-cargo.text: Turned her over on the bar, didn't I. Six crates of the feast are bobbing about out on the shoals, past the deep water, and two of them out past the outer bar; go round by the channel at the harbour end of it. Take the Herring, the boat by the steps; she rows true. They won't stay afloat long once the tide's on them.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.opt.0.label: Anything worth seeing?
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.opt.1.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.text: Mind the bar. The boats don't, which is how we got here.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-sights.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-sights.text: The games yard above the harbour house has prizes in its stalls, and the archery butts out along the track from the quay's far end keep a sheaf of arrows for anyone with a bow. The gulls out on the beacon point are generous, if they like the look of you. So is the hen at the croft.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.opt.0.label: An iron man?
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.opt.1.label: How is the iron man?
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.opt.2.label: How is the iron man?
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.opt.3.label: Good day to you.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-day.text: Forge is cold. Holiday. The counter by the door sells what I made this winter, for the town's pennies. And in the back stands an iron man I have been building since the snow.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-head.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-head.text: Iron, all of him, except the head. An iron man's head is a carved pumpkin, face and all, and every pumpkin in Kelderby was cut into a lantern this morning; the scarecrows will not give theirs up, so do not ask them. Put one on the anvil there once the feast's crates are landed, and he will see. The lantern cutters had a barrel of them out at the allotments, past the far end of the quay.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-headed.opt.0.label: Wake him (5 pennies).
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-headed.opt.0.tooltip: Show Torvald 5 pennies, and his iron man walks down to the square at dusk and fights beside you. Torvald will not take the job for less than 5 pennies in the party's purse.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-headed.opt.1.label: Back.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-headed.text: He has his head. He can see. Waking him is the dear part: 5 pennies to me, and he walks down to the square at dusk and stands with whoever needs standing with.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-hired.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-hired.text: He will be on the square when the sun goes down. Do not ask him to dance.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-wake.opt.0.label: Done.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-wake.opt.0.tooltip: Pay Torvald 5 pennies to wake his iron man for the dusk.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-wake.opt.1.label: Back.
source.dlg.torvald.torvald-wake.text: 5 pennies. Charcoal, bellows and a week of my sleep. Done?
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.0.label: Anything worth seeing?
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.1.label: Give me the bow.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.1.tooltip: Take Vidar's bow and arrows and shoot the target in the bell tower.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.text: By-law fourteen: the bell rings at dusk. The rope snapped this morning, and the knot is caught on the archery target up in the tower's opening, where nobody can reach it. I have a bow. I have never once hit anything with it. Three clean hits would shake the knot free.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-sights.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-sights.text: By-law nine: the herb stall in the cathedral's garden feeds whoever is hungry. By-law twelve: on festival day, and on no other, a pig may be ridden through the cathedral, in at the side door and out at the front, if it is racing. Ask Oskar. The by-laws are very clear on pigs. By-law three: no feeding the cat by the duck pond. Nobody has ever obeyed by-law three. The cat has seen to that.
source.fx.dusk.done.1.outcome: You held the raiders off the stage, and Oskar's cake stood whole.
source.fx.dusk.done.11.narrate: Night. Bunting and lanterns go up across the main street, the whole town comes up it to the square, and the festival begins.
source.fx.dusk.done.12.narrate: Night. The striped sails are out past the lighthouse, and the cake and the feast go with them. The town comes up the main street to the square anyway, because it always has.
source.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.13.narrate: Bernt has carted the castle's crossbows down to the stage with whatever rockets the day saved. 'Load the rocket where the bolt goes. Point it at the boats. Not at the cake.'
You come round on a bench in the inn's taproom across the square. Somebody has left you a pie.
The lighthouse beam swings round and holds: more boats running up on the beach past the harbour! Thirty breaths away.
source.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.22.narrate: Clank. Clank. Torvald's iron man walks up onto the square with a pumpkin for a head, and turns to face the bay.
source.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.3.outcome: Moss was not back by dusk; Runa spent the festival on the flank with a lantern, calling for her.
source.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.8.narrate: A horn from the bay. Three low boats with striped sails: raiders, come for the festival and, says Hedda, very specifically for the cake.
source.fx.dusk.oc.hold-the-beach.1.narrate: A bigger horn. A man in a hat with a feather that could take an eye out stands up in the last boat and points at the cake.
source.fx.dusk.oc.hold-the-dock.1.narrate: A bigger horn. A man in a hat with a feather that could take an eye out stands up in the last boat and points at the cake.
source.fx.opening.done.0.narrate: Hedda, to the whole square: 'Kelderby! Everything is under control!' Behind her, somebody runs past shouting about goats.
source.fx.opening.done.3.narrate: Oskar sets the festival cake on its table on the stage: four tiers and a sugar lighthouse.
source.fx.shop.bakery.0.0.narrate: Oskar wraps three loaves in a cloth. 'Not on the cake's table, please.'
source.fx.shop.bakery.0.1.narrate: Oskar looks at your empty hand. 'Bread is a penny. Even today.'
source.fx.shop.bakery.1.0.narrate: Oskar hands over a pie as if it were a small cake. 'Eat it sitting down.'
source.fx.shop.bakery.1.1.narrate: Oskar looks at your empty hand. 'Pie is a penny. Even today.'
source.fx.shop.forge.0.0.narrate: Torvald lays a sword across your palms. 'Edge out. Always edge out.'
source.fx.shop.forge.0.1.narrate: Torvald counts your pennies, then the sword's worth. 'No.'
source.fx.shop.forge.1.0.narrate: Torvald knocks twice on the shield and hands it over. 'It will take more than that.'
source.fx.shop.forge.1.1.narrate: Torvald counts your pennies, then the shield's worth. 'No.'
source.fx.shop.forge.2.0.narrate: Torvald sets the helmet on your head himself and nods at it.
source.fx.shop.forge.2.1.narrate: Torvald counts your pennies, then the helmet's worth. 'No.'
source.fx.shop.forge.3.0.narrate: Torvald buckles the breastplate on you and steps back to look. 'Good.'
source.fx.shop.forge.3.1.narrate: Torvald counts your pennies, then the plate's worth. 'No.'
source.fx.shop.stable.0.0.narrate: Runa counts your pennies twice and leads Moss out to the hitching rail by the square. 'Not past dusk. And she does not like the sea.'
source.fx.shop.stable.0.1.narrate: Runa looks at your pennies and then at you. 'That is not a horse's worth.'
source.fx.shop.stable.0.2.outcome: You hired Moss from Runa for four Festival Pennies.
source.fx.the-bell.oc.ring-the-bell.0.outcome: You put three arrows in the belfry target and rang the festival bell on time.
source.fx.the-bell.oc.ring-the-bell.2.narrate: The bell rings out over the square. Vidar, with tears in his eyes, says it is exactly on time, and notes it in his book.
source.fx.the-cargo.oc.ask-sverre.1.narrate: Sverre, darkly: 'And mind the drowned out on the shoals. They have had a very boring morning.'
source.fx.the-cargo.oc.crate-1.0.outcome: You rowed out and emptied crate 1 into the boat.
source.fx.the-cargo.oc.crate-2.0.outcome: You rowed out and emptied crate 2 into the boat.
source.fx.the-cargo.oc.crate-3.0.outcome: You rowed out and emptied crate 3 into the boat.

source.fx.the-cargo.oc.crate-6.0.outcome: You rowed out and emptied crate 6 into the boat.
source.fx.the-cargo.oc.land-the-cargo.0.outcome: You landed enough crates for a feast, just.
source.fx.the-cargo.oc.land-the-cargo.1.outcome: You landed too few crates for a feast; the tables held mostly bread.
source.fx.the-cargo.oc.land-the-cargo.3.narrate: Sverre counts the crates twice. 'Enough for a feast. Just.'
source.fx.the-cargo.oc.land-the-cargo.4.narrate: Sverre counts the crates, then counts them again, hoping. 'Bread, then. Lots of bread.'
source.fx.the-cargo.ox.crate-1.0.outcome: Crate 1 shipped water and spoiled before you reached it.
source.fx.the-cargo.ox.crate-1.1.narrate: Out on the shoals, crate 1 ships water, and the feast in it is spoiled.

source.fx.the-cat-cave.oc.carry-pip.3.narrate: You tip Pip into the upper pond. Pip sinks to the bottom, turns round twice and smiles the way axolotls smile, which is always.
source.fx.the-cat-cave.oc.carry-pip.5.narrate: The cat walks out to the cave mouth, sits down in the sun, and closes her eyes. 'Good. The cat has eaten, the cat has done a kindness. Now the cat sleeps.'
source.fx.the-cat-cave.oc.meet-pip.1.narrate: The cat pushes a dented bucket at you with its head. 'Scoop. Gently. Pip bites only people the cat dislikes.'
source.fx.the-cat-den.oc.down-to-the-den.1.narr: On the far ledge, out of the wind that comes up the chasm: the cat's den. A cushion worn into the shape of a cat, a grindstone, the cat's old dish, a board of fishes on the wall, and a chest. Behind you, in the cold light, the great stone thing in the chasm goes on not looking at you.
The cat leans on the old loom in the hut's back corner until it slides aside. Under it is a trapdoor, and under that a ladder going down a very long way into the dark. 'The cat's. Go on. The cat will wait up here. Mind the bridge.'
source.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-1.0.narrate: The cat eats the first cod in three bites, eyes closed, like someone who has had cod in a great many harbours and is comparing.
source.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-2.0.narrate: The cat looks at the second cod for a long moment, the way a fencer looks at a stranger's stance, and then eats it anyway.
source.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-3.0.narrate: The cat eats the third cod slowly. 'Cold water. A shady pond. Acceptable.'
source.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-4.0.narrate: The fourth cod goes the way of the others. The cat licks one paw, and for a moment her claws come out, long and very clean.
source.fx.the-cat.oc.feed-the-cat-5.0.narrate: The cat finishes the fifth cod and sits up, enormous and satisfied. 'Good. Now the cat will show you a friend. A clever friend. Follow. Do not dawdle.'
source.fx.the-cat.oc.meet-the-cat.1.narrate: The cat noses an old fishing rod out from under the bench. It has been looked after: the line is new and the hook is very sharp.
source.fx.the-festival.done.0.narrate: Runa watches the show from the square, a carrot in her pocket for the mare back in her stall.
source.fx.the-festival.done.1.narrate: Out on the flank a lantern bobs between the orchard trees: Runa, still calling for her mare, missing every rocket.
source.fx.the-festival.done.10.narrate: Oskar's cake stands on the stage, four tiers and a sugar lighthouse, without a mark on it.
source.fx.the-festival.done.2.narrate: The lighthouse beam sweeps over the square, and every face turns up into it as it passes.
source.fx.the-festival.done.3.narrate: On the stroke of midnight the festival bell rings the festival in.
source.fx.the-festival.done.31.narrate: The castle's fireworks fill the whole sky over the town, and keep filling it until the dogs give up barking.
source.fx.the-festival.done.32.narrate: A few rockets go up, one after another, a polite gap between each. The town cheers every one of them, individually.
source.fx.the-festival.done.33.narrate: Hedda unfolds the other speech, the one she wrote for the other kind of festival, and reads it to the empty tables.
source.fx.the-festival.done.34.narrate: There is no feast. There is no cake. The raiders are eating both somewhere out at sea, and the town stands on the square with its hands in its pockets.
source.fx.the-festival.done.35.narrate: Sverre's crates were landed this morning for nothing: the smoked fish and the cheeses went out to sea in the raiders' boats.
source.fx.the-festival.done.36.narrate: Kettil's goats chew on the empty feast tables. They are the only ones in Kelderby who eat tonight.
source.fx.the-festival.done.37.narrate: Bernt fires a rocket after the boats. It falls short into the bay, and nobody cheers.
source.fx.the-festival.done.4.narrate: The feast is laid out along the square: smoked fish, cheeses, honey cakes and a whole ham, all fished out of the bay this morning.
source.fx.the-festival.done.5.narrate: The feast tables hold bread, a great deal of bread, and a single heroic cheese.
source.fx.the-festival.done.6.narrate: Kettil's three goats watch the festival from their pen on the main street, chewing in time with the music.
source.fx.the-festival.done.7.narrate: Kettil's two goats watch the festival from their pen on the main street. Kettil watches them, and not the rockets.
source.fx.the-festival.done.9.narrate: Three goats stand on the stage through the whole speech, and the Admiral eats a page of it.
source.fx.the-fox.done.2.respawn.0.narrate: You come round on a bench in the inn's taproom across the square.
source.fx.the-fox.done.3.narrate: Noon. Down on the square Hedda is ringing a handbell, which is not the festival bell, and shouting for everybody to come back to the stage for the evening.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.1.narrate: The fox sits down in front of its den with the key in its mouth and looks at you as if you were the one being unreasonable.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.2.respawn.0: You come round on the road outside the castle gate, the gatehouse between you and the yard.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.3.answers.n: A cold fire, laid and waiting. Somebody will light it when the gate is reached.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.3.rest_tool: Rest by the fire: if you fall at the castle, you come round here.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.fetch-the-fireworks.0.outc: You carried the castle's whole store of rockets out of the storeroom.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.fetch-the-fireworks.2.narr: The storeroom is stacked to the rafters with rockets. Down on the square, Bernt will say 'Oh, good,' in a voice that means he had given up.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.find-the-note.0.narrate: The steward's note, in a cramped hand: 'For the watch, when I am not here: the watch fires on the walls are lit as the household rises. The cook is up first: hers is at the wall walk's end under the kitchen tower. The porter rises next to open the gate: his is at the wall walk's end under the gatehouse. Then the steward: mine is in the turret on the far wall, on the kitchen side. The lord rises last of all: his is in the turret on the far wall, on the gatehouse side. Light one out of turn, and every fire on the walls goes out. B.'
source.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-1.0.narrate: The fox bolts out from cover and streaks on up the road.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-2.0.narrate: The fox bolts out from cover and streaks on up the road.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-3.0.narrate: The fox bolts out from cover and streaks on up the road.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-4.0.narrate: The fox bolts out from cover and streaks on up the road.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.lift-the-grate.1.narrate: As you come back into the yard, the iron grate over the cellar door draws up on its chains: the fourth fire has done it.
source.fx.the-fox.ox.fetch-the-fireworks.0.outc: You reached the storeroom too late: half the rockets had gone down the hill and the fox had chewed the fuses on the rest.
source.fx.the-fox.ox.fetch-the-fireworks.1.narr: By the time you reach the storeroom, Bernt has sent half the rockets down the hill with the stable boys, and the fox has chewed the fuses on the rest of the top shelf. Half a show, then.
source.fx.the-free-traders-cellar.oc.meet-magnh: Magnhild gives you a lantern with no glass in it, the society's old signal, and three Festival Pennies out of a sugar tin. 'Members now, the lot of you. Nine was always the right number. Ten's better.'
source.fx.the-free-traders.oc.find-the-cellar.4: The ledger sitting deeper than the rest on the ledger shelf gives under your hand with a click, and next door in the cloth store something heavy falls over. Where a bolt of brown cloth stood on end in the corner there is a square hole in the boards, a ladder going down, and a smell of candles. From down there, somebody is singing, badly, about a boat with no lamp.
source.fx.the-goats.oc.pen-the-goats.0.outcome: You led all three goats into the pen and dropped the latch.
source.fx.the-goats.oc.pen-the-goats.2.narrate: Kettil counts them twice, then a third time. 'Pearl. Barley. The Admiral.' He shakes your hand with both of his.
source.fx.the-goats.ox.pen-the-goats.0.outcome: Kettil gave up waiting, fetched his goats himself, and left them standing on the stage.
source.fx.the-goats.ox.pen-the-goats.7.narrate: Kettil gives up on you, takes his bucket up the slopes himself, and comes back with three goats and no temper left. Where he has put them, he will not say.
source.fx.the-iron-man.oc.head-the-iron-man.1.o: You found Torvald a carved pumpkin, and his iron man has a head.
source.fx.the-iron-man.oc.head-the-iron-man.2.n: Torvald turns the pumpkin in his hands, nods once, and carries it into the back. A long, slow clank. 'He can see. Now he only wants waking, and waking costs: five pennies, paid to me, and he stands on the square with you at dusk.'
source.fx.the-iron-man.oc.wake-the-iron-man.2.o: You paid Torvald to wake his iron man, and it stood with you on the square at dusk.
source.fx.the-iron-man.oc.wake-the-iron-man.3.n: Torvald pockets the pennies without counting them. 'Charcoal. Bellows. A week of my sleep. He will be on the square when the sun goes down.'
source.fx.the-lamp.done.3.narrate: Inga's voice comes up the stairwell: 'While you're up there, have a look through my spyglass. Something has been bothering the castle road all morning.'
source.fx.the-lamp.oc.light-the-lamp.0.outcome: You lit the great lamp, and its beam swung out over the bay.
source.fx.the-lamp.oc.light-the-lamp.2.narrate: The lamp catches, and the beam swings out over the bay. Inga, far below, cheers once and then pretends she didn't.
You rode Moss back into the stable yard before dusk; Runa watched the fireworks from the square.
Moss walks into the stable yard as if she had never been anywhere. Runa pats her neck and says nothing at all.
source.fx.the-nisse-hall.oc.meet-the-nisse.2.na: The nisse fishes under the table and holds out a cap, much darned. 'Here. For the butter. It was good butter.'
source.fx.the-nisse.oc.feed-the-nisse.5.narrate: The porridge is hardly in the bowl before the bowl is empty. A hay bale in the bay beside the bowl rolls aside by itself, and under it is a hole in the floor with a ladder in it. From somewhere below, a small cross voice: 'Well? Come down, then. Wipe your feet.'
source.fx.the-pig-race.oc.run-the-pig-race.0.na: Oskar chalks the places up on the board, licks the chalk, and declares the pigs the real winners.
source.fx.the-pig-race.oc.take-the-dare.7.narra: Oskar's cart rattles you down the lanes to the meadow track, where the racing pigs stand saddled in a row. Ulla the carter is already up on hers, grinning. The town has turned out along the course.
source.fx.the-pig-race.oc.take-the-dare.9.narra: Up on a pig, and the race begins. Hold the carrot out ahead of it to steer. Every checkpoint counts, in order: miss one and you go back for it.
source.fx.trig.belfry-shot.1.narrate: Thock. The rope's knot jumps on the target.
source.fx.trig.cake-taken.1.outcome: A raider reached the stage, and the raiders carried Oskar's cake and the whole feast off to sea.
source.fx.trig.cake-taken.3.narrate: A raider bounds onto the stage, snatches Oskar's cake off its table and is gone with it. A horn from the bay: the raiders run for their boats with the cake held high, and the feast's tables go with them.

source.fx.trig.castle-lever-1.4.narrate: Somewhere in the castle, something heavy shifts in the stone.
