source.fx.trig.find-bonfire-green.0.narrate: On a stone by the bonfire, somebody has left two rounds of toast and a long fork. They are still warm.
source.fx.trig.find-cliff-path.0.narrate: Halfway down the cliff path a puffin stares at you from a ledge. It leaves a feather behind when it goes, possibly on purpose.
source.fx.trig.find-croft.0.narrate: A hen in the croft's yard lays an egg directly in front of you, looks at you as if you should be impressed, and walks off.
source.fx.trig.find-dune-cottage.0.narrate: Wind chimes of shells hang over the dune cottage's door. One has fallen into the sand. Held to your ear, it hums.
source.fx.trig.find-games-yard.0.narrate: Behind the games yard's fence: a basket of festival balls nobody is watching. Throw one at a friend.
source.fx.trig.find-lantern-yard.0.narrate: In the lantern yard one of the finished lanterns has a moth inside it that will not leave. The lantern maker says you may as well take that one.
source.fx.trig.find-lantern-yard.1.give: The Lantern With a Moth In It
source.fx.trig.find-lookout.0.narrate: Wedged in a crack of the lookout's rock, out of the rain: a brass spyglass, somebody's, long ago. The whole town is in it, and a cat asleep on a roof.
source.fx.trig.find-net-green.0.narrate: Tangled in the drying nets: a bottle with a note in it. It says, in a careful round hand: 'Whoever finds this: the gulls are planning something.'
source.fx.trig.find-poi-hut.0.narrate: In the herder's hut a pot hangs over a banked fire, and a note beside it says 'Help yourself. Not the goat.'
source.fx.trig.find-terrace-cottage.0.narrate: Somebody's grandmother leans out of the terrace cottage's window and presses a twist of paper on you: three biscuits, still warm, for the festival.
source.fx.trig.find-west-orchard.0.narrate: One apple at the very top of the oldest tree in the terrace orchard is gold. It drops into your hands as if it had been waiting.
source.fx.trig.fire-cook.1.narrate: The fire catches: the cook's watch fire burns on the wall.
source.fx.trig.fire-cook.9.narrate: Out of turn! The fire flares up in your face, and every watch fire on the walls gutters out.
source.fx.trig.fire-lord.1.narrate: The fire catches: the lord's watch fire burns on the wall.
source.fx.trig.fire-lord.11.narrate: Out of turn! The fire flares up in your face, and every watch fire on the walls gutters out.
source.fx.trig.fire-lord.4.narrate: With the fourth watch fire burning, chains rattle inside the walls, toward the cellar door.
source.fx.trig.fire-porter.1.narrate: The fire catches: the porter's watch fire burns on the wall.
source.fx.trig.fire-porter.9.narrate: Out of turn! The fire flares up in your face, and every watch fire on the walls gutters out.
source.fx.trig.fire-steward.1.narrate: The fire catches: the steward's watch fire burns on the wall.
source.fx.trig.fire-steward.9.narrate: Out of turn! The fire flares up in your face, and every watch fire on the walls gutters out.
source.fx.trig.garrison-wakes.1.narrate: From inside the castle walls comes a clatter of old iron, and the creak of things that should not stand up: the castle's old garrison, getting up in its yard.
source.fx.trig.gate-bell.0.narrate: The bell clangs down the mountain, and the carter's cart rattles up the road. Whoever stands on the road rides down to the square.
source.fx.trig.grate-shut.0.narrate: The grate will not lift. Its chains run into the walls, up to the watch fires on the walls. Bernt's note, he said, is in his chest by the well.
source.fx.trig.inn-bell.0.narrate: The bell clangs across the yard, and the carter whips up his horse. Whoever stands in the yard rides up the mountain to the castle gate.
source.fx.trig.pen-admiral.2.narrate: The Admiral is in the pen, and settles by the hay rack as if he had never left.
source.fx.trig.pen-barley.2.narrate: Barley is in the pen, and settles by the hay rack as if she had never left.
source.fx.trig.pen-pearl.2.narrate: Pearl is in the pen, and settles by the hay rack as if she had never left.
source.fx.trig.porridge-pot.1.narrate: A covered pot on the hay, still warm: porridge, a lump of butter melting on top, and a ladle. You fill a bowl.
source.fx.trig.race-start.2.narrate: Oskar drops his apron, and the pigs are off. Ulla whoops and goes with them.
source.fx.trig.ring-for-glow.4.narrate: The bell booms, and every raider in the town lights up like a lantern.
source.fx.trig.runa-runs.1.outcome: You sent Runa running to her sister's cow, which was not calving, and took Moss while she was gone.
source.fx.trig.runa-runs.4.narrate: Runa drops her brush and runs. Out at the hitching rail by the square, Moss stands saddled and looks at you with interest.
source.fx.trig.scarecrow-allotments-strike.0.na: That is the scarecrow's head, not a lantern pumpkin. The lantern ones are in the barrel by the compost.
source.fx.trig.scarecrow-allotments-use.0.narra: That is the scarecrow's head, not a lantern pumpkin. The lantern ones are in the barrel by the compost.
That pumpkin is the scarecrow's head. He would look silly without it. Leave it be.

source.fx.trig.scarecrow-wheat-field-strike.0.n: That pumpkin is the scarecrow's head, and the crows know it. Leave it be.

source.fx.trig.spot-the-fox.1.narrate: Through the spyglass: on the castle road, a fox trotting uphill with something bright in its mouth. Inga squints up the stair: 'That's Bernt's storeroom key. The fireworks are locked in there.'
source.fx.trig.take-the-key.2.narrate: The fox considers you for a long moment, then opens its mouth and lets you take the key. It looks offended.

source.obj.dusk.back-to-the-stage.hint: Up the main street to the stage on the square, where Hedda is watching the sea. Get ready before you tell her so: buy iron at Torvald's counter, fill your bags, bring whatever the town has given you. Once the horn blows, the rest of the town waits until the raid is over.
source.obj.dusk.back-to-the-stage.record: Hedda called the whole town back to the stage at dusk.
source.obj.dusk.back-to-the-stage.title: Ready for the raiders
source.obj.dusk.hold-the-beach.hint: Along the cliff path from the lighthouse side, coming up the last side street.
source.obj.dusk.hold-the-beach.record: A second landing of raiders came ashore on the beach by the harbour.
source.obj.dusk.hold-the-beach.title: Drive off the beach landing
source.obj.dusk.hold-the-dock.hint: Down the main street toward the quay: the raiders coming up from the boats.
source.obj.dusk.hold-the-dock.record: Raiders landed at the quay at dusk and came up the main street for the festival.
source.obj.dusk.hold-the-dock.title: Drive off the dock landing
source.obj.dusk.stop-the-captain.hint: Up the main street from the quay: the captain and his last push.
source.obj.dusk.stop-the-captain.record: Captain Gull landed last and led his best up the main street, after the cake.
source.obj.dusk.stop-the-captain.title: Stop the captain
source.obj.opening.hear-the-host.hint: On the stage on the square, by the cathedral's front.
source.obj.opening.hear-the-host.record: Hedda, the host, opened the festival from the stage on the square.
source.obj.opening.hear-the-host.title: Hear the host
source.obj.the-bell.ask-vidar.hint: At the top of the main street, just below the square: the clerk with the bow.
source.obj.the-bell.ask-vidar.record: Vidar, the guildhall clerk, could not ring the festival bell: its rope had snapped and the knot was caught on the target in the bell tower.
source.obj.the-bell.ask-vidar.title: Speak to the clerk
source.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.answers.done: The bell sings out over the square.
source.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.answers.not_y: A dull clunk. The rope's knot is still caught in the tower.
source.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.hint: Three arrows into the target in the bell tower's opening, from the top of the main street. Then use the bell on the close.
source.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.record: Three arrows in the belfry target would shake the rope's knot free, so the bell could ring.
source.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.title: Shoot the belfry target
source.obj.the-cargo.ask-sverre.hint: Down the main street on the quay, by the slip.
source.obj.the-cargo.ask-sverre.record: Sverre the boatwright turned his cargo boat over on the bar, and the feast's six crates floated off across the cove.
source.obj.the-cargo.ask-sverre.title: Speak to the boatwright
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-1.hint: Row out from the slip below the quay to the crate behind the first sandbar on the harbour side, and open it from the boat.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-1.record: Crate 1 of the feast floated behind the first sandbar on the harbour side, and would not stay there long.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-1.title: Fish out a crate
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-2.hint: Row out from the slip below the quay to the crate in the lagoon in the middle of the shoals, and open it from the boat.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-2.record: Crate 2 of the feast floated in the lagoon in the middle of the shoals, and would not stay there long.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-2.title: Fish out a crate
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-3.hint: Row out from the slip below the quay to the crate behind the first sandbar on the lighthouse side, and open it from the boat.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-3.record: Crate 3 of the feast floated behind the first sandbar on the lighthouse side, and would not stay there long.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-3.title: Fish out a crate
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-4.hint: Row out from the slip below the quay to the crate inside the outer bar on the lighthouse side, and open it from the boat.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-4.record: Crate 4 of the feast floated inside the outer bar on the lighthouse side, and would not stay there long.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-4.title: Fish out a crate
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-5.hint: Row out from the slip below the quay to the crate out past the outer bar, by its channel, and open it from the boat.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-5.record: Crate 5 of the feast floated out past the outer bar, by its channel, and would not stay there long.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-5.title: Fish out a crate
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-6.hint: Row out from the slip below the quay to the crate out past the outer bar, on the lighthouse side, and open it from the boat.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-6.record: Crate 6 of the feast floated out past the outer bar, on the lighthouse side, and would not stay there long.
source.obj.the-cargo.crate-6.title: Fish out a crate
source.obj.the-cargo.land-the-cargo.hint: Back up the slip and along the quay to the harbour house, where Sverre is counting.
source.obj.the-cargo.land-the-cargo.record: The crates saved from the bay had to be landed at the harbour house for Sverre to count.
source.obj.the-cargo.land-the-cargo.title: Land the cargo
source.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.answers.done: Pip is at home in the upper pond, and does not look back.
source.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.answers.missi: The upper pond is waiting for Pip. Hold Pip's bucket and tip it in here.
source.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.answers.not_y: A mossy rim over a still little pond. Somebody small would like it here.
source.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.hint: Up the mossy steps at the back of the cave: hold Pip's bucket and use it on the mossy rim of the upper pond.
source.obj.the-cat-cave.carry-pip.title: Carry Pip up
source.obj.the-cat-cave.follow-the-cat.hint: The cat trots off to the hill behind the cathedral: out through the far side of the cathedral garden, along the path at the foot of the hill to a cave mouth hung with moss.
source.obj.the-cat-cave.follow-the-cat.record: The cat led the way to a lush cave, where her friend Pip the axolotl, who knows his fish, wanted the upper pond.
source.obj.the-cat-cave.follow-the-cat.title: Follow the cat
source.obj.the-cat-cave.meet-pip.hint: Inside the cave, by the lower pond, where the cat sits.
source.obj.the-cat-cave.meet-pip.title: The cat's friend
source.obj.the-cat-cave.scoop-pip.hint: In the cave's lower pond: hold the water bucket and use it on Pip, the pink axolotl.
source.obj.the-cat-cave.scoop-pip.title: Scoop up Pip
source.obj.the-cat-den.down-to-the-den.hint: In the hut's back corner: down the ladder under the trapdoor, along the ledge, and over the bridge to the far side.
source.obj.the-cat-den.down-to-the-den.title: Across the chasm
source.obj.the-cat-den.follow-the-cat-home.hint: The cat trots all the way up the castle road: at its last bend before the castle, a track leads off across the high ground to an old miner's hut.
source.obj.the-cat-den.follow-the-cat-home.reco: The cat gave in at last, and showed the way to her den, across a chasm under the castle.
source.obj.the-cat-rounds.ask-the-cat-1.record: The cat sat at the cave mouth in the sun and would not be bothered.
source.obj.the-cat.catch-cod.hint: Fish the duck pond with the cat's old rod until you hold five cod. Salmon and the rest do not count: the cat asked for cod.
source.obj.the-cat.catch-cod.title: Five cod for the cat
source.obj.the-cat.feed-the-cat-1.answers.missi: The cat looks at your empty hand, then at the dish, then at you. Cod. In the hand. In the dish.
source.obj.the-cat.feed-the-cat-1.answers.not_y: One of the cat's five dishes. The cat is not hungry for nothing. Fish first.
source.obj.the-cat.feed-the-cat-1.hint: Hold a cod and put it in the first of the cat's five dishes in a row beside her on the pond bank, counting from the far end.
source.obj.the-cat.feed-the-cat-1.title: Feed the cat (1 of 5)

source.obj.the-cat.feed-the-cat-5.title: Feed the cat (5 of 5)
source.obj.the-cat.meet-the-cat.hint: By the duck pond off the farm track, on the bank across from the track.
source.obj.the-cat.meet-the-cat.record: A big grey cat by the duck pond wanted five cod out of the pond, and talked.
source.obj.the-cat.meet-the-cat.title: The talking cat
source.obj.the-festival.open-the-festival.hint: On the stage on the square, where the whole town is waiting.
source.obj.the-festival.open-the-festival.recor: Hedda opened the night's festival on the square, made of whatever the day had managed.
source.obj.the-festival.open-the-festival.title: Tell Hedda to begin
source.obj.the-fox.clear-the-yard.hint: Inside the castle gate, in the yard: the castle's old garrison, dead these hundred years and still on duty.
source.obj.the-fox.clear-the-yard.record: The castle's old garrison, dead a hundred years, still kept the yard.
source.obj.the-fox.clear-the-yard.title: Drive off the old garrison
source.obj.the-fox.corner-the-fox.hint: At the top of the castle road, by the castle gate: the fox's den under the gate road's bank.
source.obj.the-fox.corner-the-fox.record: The fox ran home to its den under the bank by the castle gate, the key still in its mouth.
source.obj.the-fox.corner-the-fox.title: Corner the fox
source.obj.the-fox.fetch-the-fireworks.hint: Through the lifted grate into the barrel cellars under the great hall: the steward's chest among the casks.
source.obj.the-fox.fetch-the-fireworks.record: The castle's fireworks were locked in the storeroom under the great hall, and had to be fetched before the steward gave up on them.
source.obj.the-fox.fetch-the-fireworks.title: Fetch the fireworks
source.obj.the-fox.find-the-note.hint: In the castle yard, beside the well: the steward's chest.
source.obj.the-fox.find-the-note.record: The steward's note gave the order of the watch fires on the castle's walls: the cook's under the kitchen tower, the porter's under the gatehouse, then the far wall's turrets, the steward's on the kitchen side and the lord's on the gatehouse side.
source.obj.the-fox.find-the-note.title: Find the steward's note
source.obj.the-fox.flush-1.hint: Up the castle road from the square, to the wayside spring beside the road.
source.obj.the-fox.flush-1.record: A fox ran off with the key to the castle's fireworks store, and hid at the wayside spring on the castle road.
source.obj.the-fox.flush-1.title: Find the fox
source.obj.the-fox.flush-2.hint: Further up the castle road, to the bee garden beside the road, where the fox ran.
source.obj.the-fox.flush-2.record: The fox ran on up the castle road and hid at the bee garden.
source.obj.the-fox.flush-2.title: Chase the fox
source.obj.the-fox.flush-3.hint: Further up the castle road, to the herder's hut beside the road, where the fox ran.
source.obj.the-fox.flush-3.record: The fox ran on up the castle road and hid at the herder's hut.
source.obj.the-fox.flush-3.title: Chase the fox
source.obj.the-fox.flush-4.hint: Further up the castle road, to the lookout beside the road, where the fox ran.
source.obj.the-fox.flush-4.record: The fox ran on up the castle road and hid at the lookout.
source.obj.the-fox.flush-4.title: Chase the fox
source.obj.the-fox.lift-the-grate.hint: Light the four watch fires on the castle's wall walk in the order the steward's note gives, then come back down into the yard to the cellar's grate. The wall walk is reached by the stair up the curtain wall beside the gatehouse.
source.obj.the-fox.lift-the-grate.record: The cellar grate lifted only for the four watch fires on the castle's walls, lit in the order of the steward's note.
source.obj.the-fox.lift-the-grate.title: Go back to the cellar grate
source.obj.the-free-traders-cellar.meet-magnhil: Down the ladder in the cloth store's corner, at the card table.
Magnhild, the last of the Free Traders, told who founded the society sixty-one years ago: the girl with the rowing boat sits in the festival's front row.
source.obj.the-free-traders.find-the-cellar.ans: The pushed-in ledger stays pushed in.
The merchant's ledgers: columns of figures, and none of them yours to read.
source.obj.the-free-traders.find-the-cellar.rec: Under the merchant's cloth store, behind a bolt of cloth, a ladder went down to the cellar of the Kelderby Free Traders.
source.obj.the-goats.ask-kettil.hint: Halfway down the main street, at the empty goat pen.
source.obj.the-goats.ask-kettil.record: Kettil the cooper's three goats got out of their pen on the main street and strayed up the slopes.
source.obj.the-goats.ask-kettil.title: Speak to the cooper
source.obj.the-goats.gather-wheat.hint: Down the side street past the boatwright's and out along the farm track: the wheat field.
source.obj.the-goats.gather-wheat.record: The goats would follow wheat, and the wheat was in the field out on the farm track.
source.obj.the-goats.gather-wheat.title: Fetch wheat
source.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.answers.done: The latch drops. Three goats look at you with deep suspicion.
source.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.answers.not_: Not yet: all three goats have to be in the pen first.
source.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.hint: Lead Kettil's three goats with the wheat into his pen halfway down the main street, one at a time or all together, then lower the latch. One is in the orchard on the terraces: down the main street to the fishmonger's, through its back yard onto the terrace track, and along it to the orchard above the track. One is at the wayside spring, the first stop up the castle road from the square. The old billy is in the orchard out on the farm track: along lane 5 beside the pen, and out the track past the pond.
source.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.record: Kettil's three goats had to be led back into their pen and latched in before dusk.
source.obj.the-goats.pen-the-goats.title: Pen the goats
source.obj.the-iron-man.find-a-pumpkin.hint: The lantern cutters' barrel at the allotments, past the far end of the quay.
source.obj.the-iron-man.find-a-pumpkin.record: The lantern cutters had carved pumpkins in their barrel at the allotments.
source.obj.the-iron-man.find-a-pumpkin.title: Find a carved pumpkin
source.obj.the-iron-man.head-the-iron-man.answe: The iron man's head is fitted. Torvald will not let you touch it.
Torvald taps the anvil. 'The head goes here. A carved pumpkin, if you find one.'
Torvald waves you off. 'Not now. Every pair of hands is wanted at the quay till the feast's crates are landed.'
source.obj.the-iron-man.head-the-iron-man.recor: Torvald's iron man wanted a carved pumpkin for a head.
source.obj.the-iron-man.wake-the-iron-man.hint: Torvald at his forge on the main street: 5 pennies, before dusk.
source.obj.the-iron-man.wake-the-iron-man.recor: Torvald would wake his iron man for the dusk, for five pennies.
source.obj.the-iron-man.wake-the-iron-man.title: Ask Torvald to wake the iron man
source.obj.the-lamp.ask-inga.hint: Down the main street, left along the last side street and out along the cliff path to the white lighthouse.
source.obj.the-lamp.ask-inga.record: Inga, the lighthouse keeper, needed somebody to climb her tower: the lamp had gone out in the night.
source.obj.the-lamp.ask-inga.title: Speak to the keeper
source.obj.the-lamp.climb-the-tower.hint: Up the stair inside the tower: where steps are missing, jump the gap.
source.obj.the-lamp.climb-the-tower.record: The lighthouse stair had given way in three places on the way up to the lamp room.
source.obj.the-lamp.climb-the-tower.title: Climb to the lamp room
source.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.answers.done: The great lamp burns, bright as noon.
source.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.answers.not_: A cold lamp, its wick dry.
source.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.hint: In the lamp room at the top of the tower: the great lamp in the middle.
source.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.record: The lighthouse lamp had to be relit for the evening boats.
source.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.title: Light the lamp
source.obj.the-mare-home.bring-back-the-mare.hi: Before dusk, ride Moss through the cart way off the square into the inn's stable yard.
source.obj.the-mare-home.bring-back-the-mare.re: Moss had to be ridden back into the inn's stable yard before dusk.
source.obj.the-mare.take-the-mare.record: Borrow Moss, Runa's grey mare, from the inn's stable, and bring her back before dusk.
source.obj.the-mare.take-the-mare.title: Borrow the grey mare
source.obj.the-nisse-hall.meet-the-nisse.hint: Down the ladder under the hay bale in the barn.
source.obj.the-nisse-hall.meet-the-nisse.record: The farm's nisse, owed three years of porridge, owned that he had let Kettil's goats out every festival morning, and promised to stop.
source.obj.the-nisse-hall.meet-the-nisse.title: The master of the farm
source.obj.the-nisse.feed-the-nisse.answers.don: The little bowl is scraped clean. Somebody liked it.
source.obj.the-nisse.feed-the-nisse.answers.mis: A little clay bowl on the floor by the hay bay, licked very clean. Scratched into the boards beside it: PORRIDGE, BUTTER ON TOP. DO NOT FORGET AGAIN.
source.obj.the-nisse.feed-the-nisse.answers.not: A little clay bowl on the floor by the hay bay, licked very clean. Scratched into the boards beside it: PORRIDGE, BUTTER ON TOP. DO NOT FORGET AGAIN.

source.obj.the-pig-race.run-the-pig-race.hint: Up on a pig at the line on the meadow track by the fair field, and round the course through every checkpoint in turn: up through the woods behind the farms, through the cathedral garden and the churchyard, in at the cathedral's side door and out at its great front door onto the square, down the main street, along the lower lane past the games yard, and back over the line.
source.obj.the-pig-race.run-the-pig-race.record: The pig race went round the whole town, through the cathedral and back, against a carter called Ulla.
source.obj.the-pig-race.run-the-pig-race.title: Ride the pig race
source.obj.the-pig-race.take-the-dare.hint: At the bakery's door at the top of the main street: Oskar keeps the festival's racing pigs, and races them with anyone who dares.
source.obj.the-pig-race.take-the-dare.record: Oskar the baker keeps the festival's racing pigs, and a race round the whole town for anyone who dares.
source.obj.the-pig-race.take-the-dare.title: Oskar's pig race
source.quest.dusk.goal: Come back to the stage at dusk and drive three landings of raiders off the festival.
source.quest.opening.goal: Hear the host open the festival on the stage, and hear everything go wrong at once.
source.quest.the-bell.goal: Shoot the snapped rope's knot off the target in the bell tower with three arrows, and ring the festival bell.
source.quest.the-cargo.goal: Row out into the bay in the boatwright's boats, round the shoals, and empty the feast's six floating crates into the boat before they drift away, two of them out past the sandbar, and land them at the harbour.
source.quest.the-cat-cave.goal: Follow the cat to the lush cave in the hill behind the cathedral, and carry her friend Pip the axolotl in a bucket up to the cave's upper pond.
source.quest.the-cat-den.goal: Follow the cat up the castle road to the old miner's hut, go down under its floor into the chasm under the castle, and cross the bridge to her den.
source.quest.the-cat-rounds.goal: Keep asking the cat, sat at the cave mouth, for anywhere else worth seeing, until it gives in.
source.quest.the-cat.goal: Fish five cod out of the duck pond for the talking cat, and put them in her dish.
source.quest.the-festival.goal: Hold the festival at night, made of whatever the day managed.
source.quest.the-fox.goal: Chase the fox up the castle road from hiding place to hiding place to its den, and fetch the fireworks from the castle storeroom in time.
source.quest.the-free-traders-cellar.goal: Go down the hidden ladder in the cloth store to the smugglers' cellar, and hear from Magnhild, the last of the Free Traders, who founded them.
source.quest.the-free-traders.goal: Find what the ledger shelf in the merchant's counting room hides.
source.quest.the-goats.goal: Fetch wheat from the field on the flank, lure Kettil's three goats down from the terraces, the castle road's spring and the farm orchard into his pen on the main street, and drop the latch before dusk.
source.quest.the-iron-man.goal: Find Torvald the smith a carved pumpkin for his iron man's head, and pay him to wake it for the dusk.
source.quest.the-lamp.goal: Climb the lighthouse past its broken stairs and light the lamp.
source.quest.the-mare-home.goal: Ride Runa's grey mare back into the inn's stable yard before dusk.
source.quest.the-mare.goal: Borrow Runa's grey mare from the inn's stable, hired for pennies or taken on a trick.
source.quest.the-nisse-hall.goal: Go down under the hay bale in the farmstead barn to the farm's nisse, and hear why the goats got out.
source.quest.the-nisse.goal: Find what the empty bowl in the farmstead barn is waiting for.
source.quest.the-pig-race.goal: Race Oskar's pigs round the town: up through the woods behind the farms, through the cathedral by its side door and out by its great front door, down the main street and back along the lower lane to the line.
